jobs.title: Group Product Manager, Frontier Model Protection, DeepMind
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Mountain View, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA
. Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degreeor equivalent practical experience.
10 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
5 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).

Preferred qualifications:

Master’s degree, MBA, or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field.
Direct domain experience in AI security, model defense, anti-distillation techniques, adversarial ML, and model extraction threat modeling.
Familiarity with emerging AI governance frameworks, LLM security standards (e.g., OWASP Top 10), and external safety coalitions.
Proven track record of collaborating directly with PhD-level researchers to transition novel algorithmic discoveries into low-latency, production-hardened systems.

About The Job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

In this role, you will own the product strategy for Frontier Model Protection. As foundation models achieve reasoning and multimodal capabilities, safeguarding our innovations against model extraction, unauthorized distillation, and intellectual property theft is a priority for national security and safety.

You will set the goal, governance, and defense architectures that keep our models resilient. The "product" is the model protection posture and runtime defense suite that safeguards Google DeepMind’s research assets while balancing business growth and developer innovation.

You will lead through strategy, executive alignment, and measurement. You will define how to protect model intelligence, and own trade-offs between defense posture, utility, developer experience, and commercial momentum. You will represent Google DeepMind externally—shaping safety strategies with government stakeholders and peer labs to establish safety benchmarks and evaluation standards.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $300000 - $333000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Define the multi-year product goal and strategic roadmap for frontier model protection and anti-distillation defenses across Google DeepMind.
Establish policies and runtime guardrails to balance rigorous IP defense against developer friction, model utility, and commercial growth objectives.
Develop quantitative evaluation frameworks and telemetry to measure defense efficacy and continuously validate complex trade-off decisions.
Partner with researchers and engineers to translate breakthroughs in watermarking and query analysis into globally scalable, production-grade defenses.
Secure executive alignment and lead technical engagement with peer labs and AI Safety Institutes to establish shared evaluation benchmarks.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Search
jobs.description:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

Join us to transform the way the world works.

Job Description

This role will be based in New York, San Francisco or Mountain View, CA.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

Our mission. As we enter the biggest transformation of work of our lifetime, the majority of the jobs on this planet will change over the next few years. Figuring out how humans will find their path, and earn a living, is the most important problem in the world right now, and that’s what we’re trying to solve on LinkedIn Search: our mission is to connect every professional to the right people, knowledge, and opportunities.

What this role is: In this role, you will be leading the Search Experience team. You’ll own the end-to-end user experience of what members do on the search results page, blending today’s search results with agentic, AI-powered experiences that understand intent, synthesize insights, enable exploration, and help members take action. Working closely with our ranking teams, you’ll set the vision for transforming today’s search results page into a fast, fluid, and agentic experience. You’ll shape how conversational, multimodal, and personalized interactions make Search more intuitive and valuable for the next generation of LinkedIn members.

What you’ll do: You’ll partner closely with design and engineering (alongside research, marketing, data science and other XFN peers) to reimagine the end-to-end LinkedIn search experience. As an AI-native, full-stack product builder, you’ll make ideas tangible through prototypes, demos, and rapid experimentation rather than lengthy PRDs. You’ll develop a deep understanding of model behavior and failure modes, using research, evaluations, and product judgment to balance quality, trust, latency, inference cost, and member value at 1.3 billion user scale.

Why are we here: Ultimately, behind every successful search at LinkedIn there's a human who's getting one step closer to paying their mortgage, sending their kids to school, starting a small business, or funding their retirement. Your main responsibility is to keep nudging that "successful searches" counter upwards.

Responsibilities

Lead the Search Experience team and own the end-to-end member experience on the search results page, from understanding and exploring results to refining intent and taking action.
Set the vision and roadmap for evolving LinkedIn Search from ranked results into a fast, fluid, and agentic AI experience.
Build conversational, multimodal, and personalized experiences designed for Gen Z and AI-native members.
Partner closely with design and engineering, alongside research, data science, product marketing, and ranking teams.
Operate as an AI-native product builder, bringing ideas to life through prototypes, demos, and rapid experimentation.
Develop a deep understanding of model behavior and failure modes, balancing quality, trust, latency, inference cost, and member value.
Define success metrics and use research, evaluations, UI experiments, and product judgment to improve successful search outcomes at billion-member scale.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

BS/BA Degree in a technology related field OR equivalent experience
3+ years of experience in product management or equivalent role

Preferred Qualifications

4+ years of experience in product management or equivalent role
2+ years building world-class consumer experiences (search/conversational AI experience is a plus)
Analytical experience launching and reviewing A/B tests, transforming insights into decisions
Demonstrated experience in AI intuition, evals, technical fluency, data fluency, failure analysis, prototyping, product judgment, systems thinking, economics, and iteration velocity.

Suggested Skills

Consumer Product Experience
Search Product Experience
Applied AI Fluency
Technical Storytelling

LinkedIn is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

The pay range for this role is $155,000 to $253,000. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor.

The total compensation package for this position may also include annual performance bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans. For more information, visit https://careers.linkedin.com/benefits.

jobs.description:
About Pinterest

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Pinterest is uniquely positioned across the full consumer journey, from inspiration and discovery through consideration, planning, and action. Creators bring ideas to life, Pinners signal emerging interests and intent, and advertisers help people act on what inspires them. This role will help build the data foundation on which Pinterest measures its flywheel, helping advertisers understand how their ads, creator activations and organic activity contribute to performance and business outcomes. The output of this work will be highly impactful, influencing advertiser investment, ad opportunities, and Pinterest’s differentiation in the ads measurement ecosystem. This is a foundational mission critical role that will directly influence the future success of Pinterest’s Ad Strategy.

The ideal candidate is a Principal PM leader with proven ability to drive data and signal quality for an ads measurement and performance stack. They have expertise and deep understanding of data and signal quality challenges and how to drive privacy safe data ingestion and collaboration capabilities across CAPI, Tag, Pixel, MMPs, DCR and other data sources. They have worked cross-functionally with engineering, data science, research, PMM, sales, and other partners and can translate complex measurement methods into credible, useful, and scalable products.

What You’ll Do

Own the vision, building and execution of Pinterest’s Data and Signal ingestion and connectivity strategy to drive its Ads Measurement and Performance success.
Own integration into the Pinterest ad stack and partner with ads quality, offsite and business platform teams to maximize signal utility.
Define the multi-year roadmap and drive execution to ingest and build high quality and expanded signal via partners - MMPs, data providers, RMNs, advertisers and agencies etc.
Own and design appropriate pathways to expand signal coverage through CAPI, server-to-server integrations, Tag, APIs, MMPs, clean rooms (DCR), and offline data uploads
Establish the operating model and OKRs that connect signal health to advertiser trust, measurement credibility, ad performance, and Pinterest’s broader ads strategy.
Leverage buy/build/partner approaches to move with speed.
Partner with engineering, DS, PMM and Ads product leaders to ensure signals are accurately ingested and leveraged in the Pinterest Ad Stack.
Represent Pinterest’s point of view on industry shifts—including browsers, cookies, MMPs, signal loss, and privacy regulation—and translate them into strategic product bets.

What We’re Looking For

10+ years of experience working as a Product Manager or in a related role, including 5–7+ years of substantial ads data/signals or marketing measurement experience.
Deep understanding of the data and signals ecosystem and how to ensure and improve data signal quality in an ad stack to drive measurement and performance. Areas of experience include privacy-safe measurement, MMPs, CAPI, Tag, Pixel, clean rooms and data partners.
Experience partnering with engineering, data science, analytics, research, or PMM cross-functional teams.
Strong evidence of the ability to define new products and strategies in an ambiguous space and to execute from ideation and multi-quarter roadmaps through go-to-market and adoption.
Strong ability to empathize with, anticipate the needs of, and effectively collaborate with a diverse set of stakeholders, including advertisers, creators, Pinners, and internal partners.
Deep understanding of business metrics and tradeoffs in the context of online platforms or multi-sided ecosystems.
Preferred but not required: Experience with social, video, commerce, or organic-and-paid measurement.
Preferred but not required: Experience building advertiser-facing measurement products or working with advertisers and agencies.
Preferred but not required: Understanding of attribution, incrementality, marketing mix modeling, or cross-channel measurement.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, or equivalent experience

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, GTM Product Marketing, Agentforce
jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Marketing & Communications

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

We're looking for a GTM Senior Product Marketing Manager, Agentforce to help execute and scale the go-to-market strategy for Salesforce's rapidly expanding Agentforce portfolio. In this role, you'll bring the power of an enterprise-grade AI agent platform to life through hands-on enablement programs, launch execution, and cross-functional collaboration with Product, Core PMM, and Sales teams.

You'll design and deliver compelling enablement programs, build repeatable demo and sales play content, and apply AI adoption scale strategies and tactics — turning usage signals and field insight into targeted programs that move sellers and customers from awareness to active, sustained use. You'll help sellers understand how Agentforce drives customer success and business growth. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, excel at turning complex technology into actionable field programs, and have a passion for AI and enterprise SaaS, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Go-to-Market Execution: Serve as the Agentforce GTM expert across product, marketing, sales, pricing/packaging, and operations — translating innovation into clear, actionable programs that drive adoption and revenue growth.
Consumption Model Enablement: Understand and communicate the Agentforce consumption model, helping sellers and customers navigate pricing, value realization, and Flex Credit opportunities.
Sales Plays: Create, launch, and manage quarterly sales plays aligned to product priorities, market opportunities, and field needs — driving measurable pipeline growth.
AI Agent-Driven Enablement & Slackbot Skill Building: Design and build AI-powered enablement tools — including custom Slackbot skills and agent workflows — that turn manual, multi-source seller research into instant, accurate, actionable guidance (e.g., eligibility checks, pricing/quoting assistance, FAQ and objection-handling lookups), and iterate on them based on field usage and feedback.
Adoption Acceleration: Own, partner, and drive adoption of Agentforce across the field — building programs and feedback loops that identify adoption blockers, track funnel/usage metrics, and turn insight into targeted enablement sales plays.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner across Corporate Strategy, Core Product Marketing, Product Management, Product Enablement, Sales Program Management, Strategic Events, and cross-cloud GTM teams to ensure alignment and flawless execution.
Product Expertise: Maintain a grasp of the Agentforce product, understanding its architecture, capabilities, and roadmap to inform enablement and messaging.
Presentation Delivery: Build and deliver high-impact presentations and demos for internal enablement sessions.
Enablement Programs: Design and deliver compelling enablement programs and content (training materials, FAQs, talk tracks, demo guides, etc.) that empower technical and non-technical sellers alike.
Field Readiness: Partner with global go-to-market and distribution leaders to drive adoption, readiness, and pipeline acceleration across all selling teams.
Content Development: Develop and maintain repeatable GTM assets — including sales plays, messaging frameworks, competitive content, and demo libraries — aligned to launch and campaign rhythms.
Sales Communications: Communicate sales updates, ensuring consistent storytelling and alignment across global teams and product pillars.
Cross-Cloud Alignment: Act as the Agentforce subject matter expert across Salesforce clouds (Sales, Service, Data Cloud, etc.) to ensure unified value messaging and solution positioning.
Pace and Adaptability: Thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and remain comfortable with ambiguity, adapting quickly while maintaining clarity, precision, and executional excellence.

Required Skills & Experience

Experience: 7+ years in Product Marketing, Solution Engineering, Sales, or Go-To-Market roles within B2B SaaS or enterprise technology.
Product Knowledge: Deep understanding of Salesforce AI, Agentforce, or comparable enterprise AI and automation platforms.
Technical Fluency: Strong grasp of Agentforce product fundamentals, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into clear business value.
Collaboration: Proven ability to partner closely with Core Product Marketers, Product Managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to align launches, messaging, and roadmap priorities.
Sales Partnership: Demonstrated experience working directly with Sales Leadership, Account Executives, and Sales Programs to translate GTM strategy into field-ready execution.
Enablement Expertise: Success in developing sales plays, enablement programs, and training materials that drive adoption and measurable pipeline impact.
Communication: Exceptional presentation and storytelling skills, capable of delivering persuasive, executive-ready content for diverse audiences.
Pricing Acumen: Familiarity with consumption-based pricing models and skill in simplifying complex pricing structures into customer-centric value narratives.
Analytical Rigor: Data-driven mindset with experience using insights to inform GTM strategy, measure success, and refine programs.
Project Management: Highly organized and effective at managing multiple priorities and timelines in a dynamic environment.
Influence: Strong collaborator and influencer, adept at driving alignment across global and cross-functional teams.
Adaptability: Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by fast-paced, evolving environments that demand creativity and focus.

Bonus

Sales Experience: Direct experience in a sales or quota-carrying role, bringing firsthand credibility and empathy for what sellers need from enablement and GTM programs.
Agentforce Familiarity: Experience supporting or marketing AI, automation, or agent-based products, and a deep curiosity about how Salesforce AI transforms business workflows.
Agent-Building & Prompt Design: Hands-on experience or strong interest in prompt design and building agents/skills on Slack's agent-building platform (or comparable platforms).
AI Tooling Fluency: Comfortable working with AI coding/assistant tools such as Codex and Claude, and staying current on recent AI news and product developments — with a genuine willingness to dive in and experiment.
Consulting Mindset: Background in management consulting (Big 4 or equivalent).
Cross-Functional Empathy: Ability to collaborate seamlessly across Product, Sales, Enablement, and Strategy with a curiosity of each team's goals and connecting the dots between them.
Strategic Agility: Comfort working in fast-paced, evolving environments, with the ability to simplify complexity and move from strategic thinking to tactical execution.
Positive Energy: A can-do, growth-oriented attitude that brings creativity, optimism, and resilience to every challenge.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

jobs.title: Director of Marketing
jobs.description:
Science is a clinical stage, vertically integrated technology company focused on solving some of neuroscience’s hardest questions and most serious unmet medical needs. We work to restore quality of life to those with debilitating conditions for which there are no treatment options, creating devices aimed at restoring vision, cognition, and mobility to patients who have lost it. To support progress across our industry, we provide state-of-the-art components and vertically integrated infrastructure for others to build on via Science Foundry.

This is an exciting time to join. PRIMA, our wireless subretinal implant for geographic atrophy secondary to age-related macular degeneration (AMD), was evaluated in the PRIMAvera pivotal study, published in the New England Journal of Medicine. Geographic atrophy is a leading cause of irreversible vision loss, and this role offers a rare opportunity to build the US marketing strategy for a genuinely new technology from the ground up. PRIMA is CE marked in the European Union and registered for supply in the United Kingdom and we are preparing for the US regulatory approval.

We are seeking a Marketing Director to shape and lead the US marketing strategy for PRIMA. Reporting to the Chief Communications Officer, this role will define how Science enters the market & builds awareness among our two key customer groups—healthcare providers and patients—and prepares the US market for PRIMA, subject to regulatory approval. You will develop the US market and launch strategy, positioning, and multi-year marketing plan, and oversee their delivery across professional education, congresses, digital, and patient advocacy channels. The ideal candidate has launched Class III medical devices in the US, brings deep experience in both HCP and patient marketing, and is comfortable operating in a fast-paced, pre-commercial environment. You will work closely with leaders across clinical, regulatory, medical affairs, and market access, and demonstrate commitment to Science's mission. This role is based in the United States.

Role Responsibilities

Develop and own the US marketing and launch strategy for PRIMA, including market segmentation, positioning, and a multi-year marketing plan aligned with regulatory milestones and company objectives
Define the HCP marketing strategy for retina specialists, ophthalmologists, optometrists, and referring clinicians, including messaging, value propositions, and professional education priorities
Define the patient and caregiver marketing strategy, including disease awareness, patient journey mapping, and partnerships with patient advocacy and low-vision organizations
Shape Science's US congress and medical education strategy (e.g., AAO, ASRS), ensuring communications remain scientific and non-promotional prior to FDA approval
Lead market research and competitive intelligence to build deep insight into the US geographic atrophy landscape, customer needs, and referral pathways
Partner with market access, reimbursement, and commercial leadership on launch readiness, including implanting center strategy and referral network development
Set the marketing budget, KPIs, and measurement framework; select and direct agency partners and hold them accountable for performance
Work with the Chief Communications Officer and the regulatory, legal, and medical affairs teams to ensure all communications comply with FDA requirements, including restrictions on pre-approval promotion

Key Qualifications

8+ years of marketing experience in the medical device industry, with progressive responsibility for marketing strategy
Direct experience launching one or more Class III (PMA) medical devices in the US
Proven experience developing and leading both HCP and patient (direct-to-consumer) marketing programs
Strong working knowledge of US medical device promotional regulations, including FDA restrictions on pre-approval promotion
Demonstrated ability to turn market insight into strategy and to influence senior leadership and cross-functional partners
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Life Sciences, or related field (or equivalent professional experience)

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in ophthalmology, retina, or neurotechnology markets
Experience building the market for a new-to-world technology or new treatment category
Familiarity with US reimbursement and market access considerations for implantable devices
MBA or advanced degree

Product Analysis – Market Analysis:

–Leads teams in adopting a customer-centric approach to identify, prioritize, and execute enhancements that provide transformative business value.

–Forecasts new product capabilities and feature designs, leveraging deep customer insights and market trends.

–Champions alignment between products and customer needs, leading initiatives to continuously adapt to, and anticipate, market shifts.

–Coordinates cross-functional collaboration, maximizing product consumer satisfaction and product success.

–Provides oversight on resolving complex and high-stakes customer issues, ensuring customer satisfaction and product quality.

Product Release – Go-to-Market:

–Guides the review, validation, and strategic coordination of delivery for the field team (e.g., release overview, field presentations, demos).

–Performs high-level review of the product adoption tracking process, ensuring improvement initiatives align with long-term strategic goals.

–Guides product demonstrations for customers, partners, industry analysts, and field, engaging key stakeholders to gather feedback.

Yahoo Search helps millions of people find information, answers, products, services, and inspiration across the web. The Search Product team is building the next generation of Yahoo Search, evolving both our traditional search results experience and new AI-powered experiences such as Scout.

Monetization is a critical part of that future. Our team is responsible for creating advertising experiences that deliver strong value for users, advertisers, and Yahoo. We work at the intersection of consumer experience, advertising technology, machine learning, data science, and business strategy, with an opportunity to both optimize a scaled existing business and define entirely new monetization models for AI-powered search.

About The Role

We are seeking a Director of Product Management, Search Monetization
to own product strategy and execution for monetization across Yahoo Search.

This is a senior individual contributor role
for a hands-on product leader with deep experience in sponsored search and search advertising. You will be responsible for improving the performance of advertising across our search results pages while protecting and improving the overall user experience. You will also help define the future of monetization for AI-powered Search, including Scout, developing new ad products and commercial experiences that feel native to how people discover information and make decisions in conversational and generative experiences.

This role combines optimization and invention. You will work deeply on ad relevance, ranking, placement, density, query coverage, marketplace dynamics, and experimentation, while also identifying and developing entirely new advertising concepts and business models.

You will partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Design, Research, Business Development, Finance, and other Product teams. Because Yahoo works with external advertising marketplaces and technology partners, you will also play an important role in defining product requirements, identifying opportunities, and working across partner ecosystems to improve monetization outcomes.

We are looking for someone who can move comfortably between strategy and execution: defining where Search monetization should go, digging into performance data to understand why RPM moved, working with engineers and data scientists on optimization opportunities, and developing new ideas for how advertising can create value in the next generation of Search.

Responsibilities

Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for monetization across Yahoo Search, spanning traditional search results pages and emerging AI-powered Search experiences.
Drive meaningful improvements in Search revenue and RPM while maintaining clear user experience guardrails and high standards for ad quality and relevance.
Optimize sponsored search across ad relevance, ranking, placement, density, presentation, query coverage, and other product and marketplace levers, including expanding monetizable query coverage where appropriate.
Define and build a scalable monetization model for Scout and other AI-powered Search experiences, inventing, prototyping, testing, and scaling new advertising formats and commercial experiences for generative, conversational, and agentic interactions.
Modernize Yahoo Search's approach to ad optimization, partnering with Engineering and Data Science on ranking systems, machine learning models, decisioning systems, experimentation capabilities, and supporting platform investments.
Develop a deep understanding of Search monetization performance, using statistical analysis, experimentation, marketplace data, and user behavior to diagnose opportunities and prioritize investments.
Design and interpret experiments in complex advertising marketplace environments, including situations where traditional experimentation is constrained by marketplace dynamics, partner systems, auction effects, or limited traffic.
Establish success metrics and measurement frameworks that balance revenue, RPM, advertiser value, ad relevance, engagement, query coverage, and user experience.
Partner closely with external advertising and technology partners, as well as Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and Design, to identify opportunities, define requirements, troubleshoot performance, launch new experiences, and move products from concept through scaled launch.
Develop a strong understanding of advertiser needs, marketplace dynamics, competitive trends, and emerging advertising models, translating those insights into new product opportunities and clearly communicating strategy, performance, and tradeoffs to senior leaders.

Minimum Qualifications

9+ years of Product Management or equivalent experience, including significant experience building and optimizing advertising or monetization products at scale.
5+ years of direct experience with search advertising, sponsored search, or closely related performance advertising products, with a strong understanding of search intent, ad relevance, advertiser value, and user experience.
Demonstrated success improving scaled advertising or monetization products through optimization, experimentation, and data-driven decision making, with strong knowledge of ad ranking, relevance, placement, coverage, yield, and marketplace dynamics.
Experience working with programmatic advertising marketplaces, external ad platforms, advertising partners, or similar multi-party ecosystems.
Strong analytical and quantitative skills, including experience interpreting statistical analyses, marketplace data, large-scale product metrics, and experiments in environments where traditional A/B testing may have limitations.
Technical fluency sufficient to work deeply with engineers and data scientists on machine learning models, ranking and decisioning systems, experimentation frameworks, data pipelines, and system architecture.
Strong product judgment and user empathy, with demonstrated ability to balance monetization and consumer experience while translating ambiguous commercial opportunities into product concepts, hypotheses, experiments, and roadmaps.
Ability to operate as a highly autonomous, hands-on senior individual contributor, moving fluidly between strategy and detailed execution and communicating complex product, technical, and business tradeoffs to senior leaders and cross-functional partners.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience owning monetization for a large-scale consumer search, commerce, marketplace, or discovery product.
Experience building or optimizing advertising products powered by machine learning, relevance models, recommendation systems, auction systems, or marketplace technology.
Experience developing new advertising formats or monetization models, including for AI-powered, conversational, generative, recommendation, or agentic consumer experiences.
Experience working across multiple external advertising or technology partners where product performance depends on systems outside your direct ownership.
Familiarity with advertiser economics, auction dynamics, conversion measurement, attribution, and other components of the advertising ecosystem.
A track record of identifying non-obvious monetization opportunities and turning them into products that create meaningful value for users, advertisers, and the business, including using AI-assisted tools for analysis, ideation, prototyping, or product discovery.

Description

Amazon Global Logistics (AGL) empowers hundreds of thousands of Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) sellers and other business customers with reliable, cross-border freight solutions — moving billions of products via ocean and air freight through the Amazon Fulfillment Network worldwide. We combine the scale of Amazon's global logistics network with real-time shipment visibility and seamless seller integration to deliver dependable, end-to-end supply chain solutions.

As Principal Product Manager for New & Emerging Geographies, you will launch new global cross-border origin-to-destination arcs and grow existing ones. You will own the product vision and roadmap with broad cross-organizational influence. This is a strategic, high-visibility, high-impact role at a pivotal moment for AGL — as we grow our product for businesses of all types amidst shifting global policies that are redefining how sellers move inventory at scale.

Drive growth performance accountability in business reviews using data analytics

jobs.title: Principal PMT, NTN Core, Amazon Leo
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Leo is building the world's most advanced Low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite constellation to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the globe. As part of this mission, we are seeking a Principal Product Manager – Technical (PMT) to define product requirements, lead feature alignment, and drive roadmap planning for the NTN Core Network globally. You will work closely with engineering teams across satellite RAN, Core, and Devices, with focus on the NTN core.

This role requires deep technical mastery of 3GPP protocols, NAS signaling, extensive experience deploying 4G/5G Packet Cores across multiple vendors, product lifecycle software release management, and the ability to translate customer experiences and user stories into detailed product requirements. The Principal Product Manager - Technical (PMT) will be at the forefront of defining NTN Core Network requirements and building 0-to-1 satellite systems for consumer, business, and government customers globally.

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities

Drive NTN Core Network feature alignment to ensure interoperability across Amazon Leo RAN, Core, Transport, and cloud infrastructure, delivering seamless connectivity and roaming services between satellite and terrestrial networks.
Own the NTN Core Network product roadmap and service delivery plan, ensuring delivery across multiple workstreams with high standards and operational excellence.
Work closely with Amazon Leo engineering teams, Payload Integration Test (PIT) and telco MNO/Device/Chipset partners to define, build, deploy and test 3GPP-compliant protocol layers, network functions, and service-based architecture, ensuring deterministic behavior, low latency, and high reliability for satellite-based connectivity and TN-NTN mobility. The Yahoo DSP Research team sits at the core of our programmatic ad platform, developing the mathematical models and algorithms that govern billions of dollars in real-time ad spend daily. We blend control theory, machine learning, and economics with modern AI-driven engineering practices to build world-class marketplace optimization systems.

About The Role

As a Principal Research Scientist (IC6) on the Yahoo DSP Optimization team, you will serve as a primary technical authority driving the next-generation architecture for budget control, pacing, and bidding algorithms. In this role, you will lead the evolution of our high-scale optimization stack by integrating agentic AI practices—shifting traditional research-to-production pipelines into highly automated, AI-augmented development loops.

Responsibilities

Lead the research, architectural design, and production deployment of large-scale algorithms for budget pacing, bid optimization, and marketplace supply/demand balancing.
Architect and spearhead the implementation of agentic AI workflows—utilizing AI coding agents, automated experiment orchestration, and agent-driven validation to dramatically accelerate research-to-production iteration velocity.
Provide technical strategy and long-term vision for the DSP optimization ecosystem in close alignment with business and engineering leadership.
Apply control theory, convex/stochastic optimization, and machine learning to solve complex, real-time marketplace dynamics under signal uncertainty.
Direct AI-assisted code refactoring, automated testing suite generation, and LLM-driven research synthesis using modern tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT) to elevate team engineering standards.
Own multi-quarter research initiatives from mathematical formulation through production rollout, establishing rigorous metrics and evaluation frameworks.
Partner closely with engineering and product management teams to ensure algorithmic designs execute seamlessly at scale.
Mentor senior scientists and engineers, setting technical excellence standards and fostering an AI-forward research culture.
Communicate technical strategy, experimental results, and architectural choices clearly to executive and cross-functional partners.

Basic Qualifications

Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Operations Research, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
8+ years of hands-on experience designing and deploying large-scale optimization, control systems, or machine learning models in production environments.
Deep mathematical foundation in probability, convex/stochastic optimization, and control theory (e.g., feedback control, model predictive control).
Demonstrated expertise in production programming languages (Python, Java, C++, SQL, or Spark) with experience in low-latency or distributed data architectures.
Active hands-on experience with AI pair-programming and developer automation tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, agentic orchestration frameworks).
Proven capability to evaluate, refine, and validate AI-generated research artifacts and code, ensuring strict safety, accuracy, and performance standards.
Demonstrated mindset of continuous experimentation, leveraging AI tools to automate repetitive engineering and diagnostic tasks.
Strong communication skills with a proven track record of translating complex mathematical concepts into clear executive strategy.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior research or production experience in computational advertising, real-time bidding (RTB) auctions, or dual-sided marketplace design.
Portfolio of peer-reviewed publications or patents in computational advertising, control theory, or applied optimization.
Experience leading system-level re-architectures utilizing agentic workflows or automated research pipelines.
Familiarity with high-throughput, low-latency distributed computing frameworks.

Deliver measurable efficiency gains in budget delivery and bid efficiency by deploying refreshed control models built via AI-augmented development loops.
Establish standardized agentic development frameworks across the optimization research organization, setting a benchmark for scientific velocity.
Serve as the recognized technical lead for DSP optimization, aligning research roadmaps with long-term business growth.

What if you could teach machines to make millions of delivery decisions — faster, smarter, and more efficiently than ever before? We're looking for a Senior Product Manager - Tech who's obsessed with the intersection of artificial intelligence and real-world operations to join Amazon's Sub Same Day team. This isn't about incremental optimization. You will define and drive the product roadmap for AI/ML-powered solutions across the Sub Same Day delivery network — from supply chain planning and real-time capacity allocation to delivery and anomaly detection. You'll identify high-impact business problems ripe for AI disruption, translate them into well-scoped technical product requirements, and build the business case to secure investment. Your multi-year product vision will leverage state-of-the-art techniques — large language models, reinforcement learning, computer vision, and graph neural networks — to fundamentally reimagine how last-mile delivery works at Amazon scale.

You will serve as the connective tissue between data scientists, system development engineers, business intelligence engineers — ensuring technical feasibility, architectural soundness, and delivery velocity. You'll drive technical debt reduction and platform scalability, ensuring AI systems are production-grade, fault-tolerant, and built for exponential growth.

You will partner with operations, logistics, finance, and science teams to ensure AI solutions are grounded in operational reality and deliver measurable business value. Understanding of the difference between a strategy and a plan, and the ability to state your current team's strategy in one sentence.

Description

Amazon Ads operates at the intersection of eCommerce and advertising, offering a rich array of digital display advertising solutions with the goal of helping our customers find and discover anything they want to buy. We help advertisers reach Amazon customers on Amazon.com, across our other owned and operated sites, on other high-quality sites across the web, and on millions of Kindles, tablets, and mobile devices. We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do, including advertising. If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing team working to build a unique, world-class advertising group with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.

Amazon Ads is looking for a Senior Product Release Manager, Global Release Management to lead release management globally for advertising products, tools and services that impact all Amazon advertisers and customers. As our ad products evolve, the Release Management team's core function is to ensure all internal services teams are systematically equipped to support advertisers be successful with our products. Beyond release planning and launch risk mitigation to protect the advertiser and customer experience, Release Management focuses on delivering operational simplification of products through upstream prioritization of features that enable effective, self-service execution for users. Release Managers build scalable processes and mechanisms with up and downstream stakeholders in order to launch, and maintain successful ad products.

The candidate will have high standards for themselves and everyone they work with, and will be constantly looking around corners to prevent short-sighted decisions. This role requires a strong ability to find creative solutions to challenging problems, excellent communication skills, ability to easily navigate ambiguity and define a path forward. You must know how to influence and motivate to get the right things done.

Key job responsibilities

While Product Managers drive product vision and technical requirements; Release Managers provide data-driven cross-product business understanding of releases impact and success. They drive shared goals and gain investments prioritization alignment. Lastly, Release Managers are excellent at driving results, able to coordinate large, multi-functional projects on-time, anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, make trade-offs, and balance business needs versus technical constraints. They are involved in reviewing product workflow design and balance near term business need with longer term implications for Amazon. They rationalize business priorities and technical requirements with cross-functional teams, effectively managing cross-functional communication to ensure all business and technical stakeholder’s needs are aligned.

This is a multi-faceted role requiring a breadth of skills and expertise:

Engage with global stakeholders to understand priorities, and drive cross-team initiatives
Identify scaled opportunities to help partners implement readiness solutions that expedite market launches and improve product performance
Track program(s) health and success by evaluating performance and deriving insights via structured analyses in order to influence strategic decisions

A day in the life

Sr. Product Release Managers lead product releases that are large in scope and impact to customers and to the advertising business. They are expected to influence product development strategy to launch the right advertising solutions for advertisers. They enable optimal business and investments decisions for upstream and downstream executing teams through providing data and insights that help identify opportunities for product automation and improved CX. Beyond RM responsibilities, they autonomously gain partner buy-in and implement mechanisms that raise the release readiness bar for all advertising Products and tools globally. They independently develop roadmaps, project plans, risks and dependency logs, releases planning calendars, status updates, and post-mortems. They build simplified processes that automate repeatable activities, promote global standardization, improve testing rigor, remove internal process bottlenecks, and drive productivity gains. They leverage their expertise of operational processes and their deep understanding of product architecture to influence prioritization of product requirements.

About The Team

jobs.title: Principal Solution Architect
jobs.description:
⠀

About Metagenics

For over 43 years, Metagenics has had the mission to help people live happier, healthier lives through the life-changing power of nutrition.

We believe the way we do business is as important as the business we do; that a company in the nourishment business should nourish its people, too. So, we incorporated healthy, sustainable care into every dimension of our culture. Our diverse and expansive team are a prime example of the power of a people-first approach. We know first-hand, when an organization prioritizes internal growth and fosters empathy, its people come together to set an example of what the world can become.

Join us in being the world’s leading healthcare professional-grade VMS company!

⠀

The Role

Metagenics is investing meaningfully in the modernization and convergence of its global technology stack. Over the next several years we will unify our enterprise systems, modernize our commerce and integration architecture, scale a portfolio of production AI programs, and evolve toward a Centers of Excellence operating

model.

To do this well, we need a Principal Solution Architect who can hold the whole picture — the systems, the data, the integrations, the security posture, the operational readiness — and set the technical direction that our teams and delivery partners execute against.

This is a highly visible role, working directly with the CTO, technology leadership, and executive stakeholders across the business. You will become the enterprise’s technical center of gravity.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture Strategy and Standards

Own the enterprise reference architecture across ERP, ecommerce, data, integration, and AI layers
Set architectural patterns, standards, and technology selection criteria that every technology function executes against
Chair the Architecture Review Board and sign off on architecturally significant decisions

Cross-functional Technical Direction

Serve as the peer-level technical advisor to each area leader across ERP, Ecommerce, Data & AI, Security, and IT Operations
Ensure major transformation programs share consistent integration, data, identity, and observability patterns
Prevent point solutions from calcifying into new legacy

Enterprise Transformation Architecture

Own the target-state architecture for our global ERP consolidation onto a single modern platform
Own the target-state architecture for our global ecommerce convergence — including B2C, B2B / practitioner, subscriptions, payments, tax, and fulfillment
Own the platform architecture for our generative AI programs — including LLM routing, retrieval patterns, data pipelines, guardrails, and observability

Middleware and Integration

Rearchitect middleware and integrations across disparate enterprise systems — evolve a large point-to-point integration estate into a governed, event-driven architecture
Set the strategic direction for the enterprise integration platform, ensuring it simplifies as major systems converge
Establish clean separation of concerns — no business logic living in middleware where it doesn’t belong

Data

Define the enterprise data architecture — master data, event streams, warehousing, and downstream consumption for BI, AI, and operational reporting
Establish clean ownership between the transactional stack and the analytical / AI stack

Security, Compliance, and Resilience

Partner with the Head of Security on architecture-level controls — identity, access, data classification, encryption, network segmentation
Ensure compliance with applicable regimes including NIS2, FSSC 22000, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and regional privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA)
Design for resilience — RTO/RPO targets, disaster recovery patterns, and business continuity

What You'll Need

Experience / Training / Education

15+ years in enterprise technology, with at least 5 years as a senior or principal-level architect at a global company
Direct hands-on architectural experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Finance & Operations and/or Customer Engagement) at scale — including multi-country / multi-legal-entity deployments
Direct experience architecting modern ecommerce platforms — Shopify strongly preferred; comparable modern commerce platforms also considered
Deep understanding of integration architecture — iPaaS platforms, event-driven patterns, API-first design
Experience architecting modern data platforms — Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Databricks, or comparable
Working knowledge of generative AI architecture — RAG, agent patterns, LLM routing, evals, and guardrails

Preferred Experience

Consumer goods, life sciences, or regulated food / manufacturing industry background
Direct experience with NIS2, FSSC 22000, ISO 27001, SOC 2 compliance regimes
Experience with practitioner or healthcare-professional channels and the pricing, payment, and rebate models that come with them
Prior experience standing up or scaling a Center of Excellence operating model

You'll Love This Job If You're

A systems thinker — able to hold the whole picture without losing sight of the seams
Decisive and pragmatic — comfortable making calls with incomplete data and revisiting them cleanly when evidence changes
Comfortable influencing at the executive level — you can carry a technical argument into a senior leadership or board conversation without losing the audience
A builder, not just a governor — you ship reference implementations, not just publish diagrams
A coach and multiplier — you make the architects and engineers around you better

Compensation

The current range for this hybrid position (3x/week in-office)
based in Jersey City, New Jersey is $180,000/yr. to $218,000/yr.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs.

This role may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Overview

Principal Product Manager
for Memory in Copilot Chat, owning customer scenarios, end-to-end product experiences, platform requirements, and AI quality/evaluation across a high-impact, cross-company area.

Microsoft Copilot is transforming how people work by helping them reason across information, stay in context, and accomplish more. Copilot Memory is a foundational part of that experience: it enables Copilot Chat to understand durable user context and deliver more personal, proactive, and trustworthy assistance while preserving enterprise-grade controls.

The Copilot Work Memory team is evolving memory from user's work context & history continuity into a governed, evaluable, multi-source capability grounded in user's real communications, documents, meetings and work content. The team is solving hard product and technical problems across memory generation, freshness, retrieval, serving, evaluation, transparency, safety, privacy, latency, and cost.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager
, to lead a large, complex product area for Memory in Copilot Chat. This role requires exceptional technical fluency, end-to-end product judgment, and a proven ability to build and ship AI-powered experiences from the ground up. You will set direction across customer scenarios, product experiences, platform capabilities, and AI quality; translate ambiguous customer and technical problems into a durable strategy and execution plan; and align engineering, applied science, design, research, security, privacy, and partner teams across Microsoft to deliver measurable customer impact. You will also establish and sustain senior cross-organization relationships with teams driving critical parts of Copilot Memory, including Chat Memory.

The ideal candidate combines customer obsession with systems thinking and organizational leadership: someone who can move comfortably from long-term product strategy and user scenarios to quality metrics, experiment design, platform tradeoffs, and executive-level decisions. You will operate with high autonomy, lead through ambiguity across a broad scope, create clarity across organizational boundaries, and establish the product practices and cross-company operating model that allow Copilot Memory to improve safely and rapidly at scale.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

Own product strategy, multi-year roadmap, and execution for a large and complex area of Work Memory in Copilot Chat, connecting customer scenarios to platform investments and measurable outcomes across multiple products and organizations.
Define and ship end-to-end AI experiences from the ground up for how Copilot captures, refreshes, retrieves, uses, explains, and allows users to control memory, taking capabilities from early concept and technical exploration through experimentation, launch, and scaled operation.
Translate customer needs, usage and feedback signals, support themes, and competitive insights into a differentiated product strategy and durable platform-level requirements, balancing near-term delivery with long-term architecture and ecosystem leverage.
Lead the product quality and evaluation strategy for your area, including representative scenario sets, rubrics, offline evaluations, synthetic or controlled test environments, online metrics, experiment design, regression protection, and failure analysis.
Partner closely with engineering and applied science on technical choices across generation, storage, retrieval, freshness, context budgeting, latency, cost, and model behavior; make clear tradeoffs and drive decisions.
Establish success measures spanning relevance, freshness, personalization utility, task completion, engagement, customer satisfaction, trust, safety, performance, and operational health.
Drive trustworthy product design through transparency, citations or explanations where appropriate, user controls, lifecycle clarity, auditability, privacy, Responsible AI, and enterprise compliance requirements.
Build and sustain senior cross-company relationships across Copilot Chat, Microsoft 365, Work IQ, agents, platform, design, research, security, privacy, marketing, and customer-facing teams; align independent roadmaps, resolve high-impact dependencies, and drive shared decisions across organizational boundaries.
Communicate strategy, quality insights, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations crisply to senior leaders and stakeholders; shape executive decisions and establish effective cross-organization product reviews and operating rhythms.
Model AI-forward product leadership through rapid learning, prototyping, data-informed iteration, direct customer engagement, and active mentorship of product managers; raise the quality bar for strategy, execution, and AI evaluation across the broader team.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development
OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

Microsoft Cloud Background Check:
This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience owning a large, complex product scope and delivering end-to-end software products, AI-powered features, or platform capabilities with measurable customer or business impact.
Technical fluency in building and evaluating AI products, with the ability to work deeply with engineering and applied science partners from early technical exploration through production launch and iteration.
Experience using data, telemetry, experimentation, product evaluations, or structured quality methods to make product decisions and improve outcomes.
Demonstrated product judgment across customer scenarios, user journeys, interaction design, prioritization, and platform tradeoffs.
Experience translating customer feedback and market or competitive signals into clear product requirements and roadmaps.
Demonstrated ability to build trusted cross-organization relationships, align and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority, and drive strategy and execution through significant ambiguity and interdependent roadmaps.
Technical fluency in building AI/ML platforms or products.
Experience taking a zero-to-one AI capability from customer problem definition and technical exploration through experimentation, launch, and scaled operation; experience with memory, personalization, search and retrieval, RAG/grounding, agentic systems, orchestration, knowledge systems, or conversational AI is especially relevant.
Experience shipping enterprise AI experiences with privacy, security, compliance, governance, safety, and Responsible AI requirements.
Experience with Microsoft 365, Copilot, or enterprise productivity products and the needs of both end users and tenant administrators.
Solid executive presence and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical, product, and organizational issues into clear decisions, commitments, and action.
A self-directed, resilient, and collaborative working style; curiosity, attention to detail, and a bias toward learning and execution.

The Agentic WorkSpaces organization envisions a world where people teams and AI collaborate securely from anywhere to create unprecedented value for every organization. We build lovable products that empower every business to unlock the full potential of human-AI teamwork driving smarter decisions greater creativity more value and faster innovation with confidence. This vision is realized through the agentic WorkSpace - a secure managed environment purpose-built for human-AI collaboration at enterprise scale where people and AI agents work side by side to deliver results neither could achieve alone.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to own End-User Experience across the Agentic WorkSpaces portfolio.

This is a strategic portfolio-level role focused on defining how people and AI agents experience interact with and derive value from our products. You will establish the end-user experience strategy principles and measurable bar across a set of products that span today's human-centered virtual desktop experiences emerging in-product agentic assistance and future fully agentic workloads. You will define the experience paradigms for agentic WorkSpaces across the full spectrum of use cases: human workloads in-app agents that assist people in completing work and headless or autonomous agentic workloads that operate on behalf of users or businesses. You will ensure that agentic interfaces are cohesive across the portfolio that product teams are building from a common set of tenets and guidelines and that the human experience becomes richer and simpler as AI capabilities expand rather than more fragmented or complex.

: In this role you will develop a deep understanding of our end-user personas their work patterns and the industry contexts in which they operate. You will clarify how the needs of a call center agent differ from those of an engineer how a financial advisor's workflow differs from a contractor's and how autonomous AI agents introduce entirely new experience requirements. You will partner closely with engineering design product go-to-market and product marketing to shape roadmaps influence product decisions and ensure that end-user experience is treated as a strategic differentiator across the organization. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

Microsoft AI Experiences is a customer‑first organization building AI‑powered products that help people and businesses achieve more. As the world undergoes a profound AI platform shift, we are looking for product leaders who can operate several steps ahead anticipating what the future will demand and translating that vision into clarity, strategy, and execution today.

As a team, we play a central role in discovery, crawling, selection, document processing & aggregation of web graph. Work in our team is unique in that you'll be able to work with trillions of documents, which pushes the boundaries of our infrastructure and computational resources. Moreover, it provides interesting challenges that haven't been encountered before, thereby combining research and product applications.

We are looking for the best and brightest to join our team and help us apply the next generation of LLM, NLP, deep learning, large scale distributed systems and informational retrieval techniques. As a Senior Product Manager, you will build the next generation of Unified Index Platform (UIP) which is being used for featurizing, filtering and indexing for Search, Grounding and Training. UIP supports all data types and structured data across web, pdf, image, video, local, shopping etc. The candidate will focus on defining KPIs for success, doing deep data analysis, writing product specifications and delivering complex large projects.

This is a highly collaborative, cross‑functional role ideal for someone who thrives in operational complexity, is deeply organized, and loves working at the intersection of people, process, and product quality. You will partner closely with engineering, research, design, data science, legal, privacy, and security teams to build compliant, scalable, high‑quality AI systems that serve hundreds of millions of users.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50- mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25-mile commute of a non-U.S., country-specific location are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

Responsibilities

Strategy & Vision
Define the multi‑year product vision and strategy for Microsoft AI Experience Index Pipelines, related Success metrics, Feedback loops, and Testing mechanisms.
Create strategies for processing all kinds of entities/data types, real time injection of critical data at scale, and on-boarding different teams that want to process and build large scale indexes.

Execution & Delivery
Define success criteria, OKRs, and KPIs across multiple product surfaces and organizational boundaries.
Establish methodologies for on-boarding SLM/LLMs and platform support for large scale publish-subscribe mechanisms.
Drive platform architecture decisions in partnership with engineering and research teams.
Plan, size, and continuously optimize capacity (compute, storage, data throughput, and cost) to build, scale, and operate training pipelines reliably.

Cross‑Functional Leadership
Partner with Legal, Privacy, Security, HR, and Compliance teams to ensure platforms are compliant‑by‑design.
Collaborate with teams across Microsoft that need to process, build or access very large indexes for Search or AI scenarios.
Define and evangelize processes for developers and researchers to improve labeling workflows, model‑as‑a‑judge systems, and agentic evaluation pipelines.

Innovation & Technical Depth
Research, design, and operationalize new evaluation techniques and metrics that improve the quality and reliability of LLM and ML‑based products.
Go deep into new technical areas quickly and provide clarity to engineering teams on requirements, architecture, and tradeoffs.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree AND 5+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development
OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development
OR equivalent experience.

4+ years experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects.
Outstanding Analytical skills
Experience in writing good detailed technical specifications for all new features
Good Understanding of LLM, Big Data, Machine Learning, and Data Mining.
Understanding of Security, Privacy and Compliance practices.
Attention to detail, planning, organization, and project management skills
Ability to quickly adapt to new technology and go deep in new focus areas.
Excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with a large number of partners and customers and translate requirements into a product vision and roadmap.

jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
Scale has been the leading AI data foundry, helping fuel the most exciting advancements in AI, including frontier model training, enterprise adoption, defense applications, and autonomous vehicles. Our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions.

Scale's evaluation and data products shape how the industry trains and measures frontier models. Our benchmarks and leaderboards influence model development and purchasing decisions across the AI ecosystem, and our data and environments help leading labs build what comes next.

These roles are deeply cross-functional. You will work across AI Product Management, ML Research, Engineering, Operations, and Go-To-Market teams, and directly with frontier AI labs and enterprise customers, representing Scale as a thought leader in how models are trained and measured. Whichever portfolio you own, you will own it end-to-end: strategy, roadmap, infrastructure, governance, customer adoption, and business impact.

PMs here operate with significant autonomy, ship frequently, and are expected to be deeply analytical and hands-on. The ideal candidate combines strong product judgment, technical fluency, operational rigor, and customer-facing experience, with a passion for turning emerging model capabilities into scalable products.

Open Roles

Senior AI PM, Coding: Own Scale's Coding portfolio, built on SWE-Bench Pro (which cut frontier scores from 70%+ to roughly 23%), SWE Atlas, and our FrontierBench contributions. You'll decide what comes next as agents saturate current tasks, and turn that benchmark credibility into revenue from SFT and preference data, RL environments, and agentic coding evals. You'll also own the coding infrastructure roadmap and our expert network of professional software engineers. This role requires hands-on software engineering depth.
Senior AI PM, Leaderboards: Own and scale the SEAL Leaderboard portfolio across all of Scale's domains, turning cutting-edge evals into trusted industry benchmarks. You'll run the Leaderboard Steering Committee, decide which leaderboards get built, and set governance standards for evaluation integrity and release cadence. This is a horizontal role, so breadth across evaluation categories and a strong public-facing presence matter more than depth in any one domain.

You Will

Own the roadmap and strategy for your portfolio, setting priorities across product development, launches, infrastructure investments, and expansion.
Drive alignment across AI-PM, ML, Engineering, Operations, and GTM stakeholders.
Evaluate, prioritize, and operationalize new product proposals, making sure they align with customer demand, model capability frontiers, and company strategy.
Define and manage the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and design to launch, scaling, maintenance, and sunset decisions.
Partner with ML researchers and domain experts to develop trustworthy evaluation methodologies, task specifications, scoring and grader design, and quality bars.
Drive the roadmap for infrastructure, automation, and operational tooling to improve scalability, reduce manual effort, and accelerate delivery.
Establish governance processes for quality, evaluation integrity, contamination prevention, reproducibility, auditability, and release management.
Work directly with frontier AI labs and enterprise customers to understand where their models fail, gather feedback, and shape future investments.
Track adoption, usage, model impact, and business outcomes, using data to guide roadmap decisions and resource allocation.
Identify new capability areas and product opportunities that strengthen Scale's leadership and create new revenue.
Collaborate closely with GTM on customer engagements, thought leadership, product launches, and strategic partnerships.

Ideally, You'd Have

5+ years of experience in product management, technical program management, consulting, or customer-facing technical roles.
Strong technical fluency with machine learning systems, AI model evaluation, benchmarking, or data products.
Experience building and scaling products that require coordination across engineering, operations, and business teams.
Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with a proven ability to drive alignment across cross-functional organizations.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate ambiguous market and customer signals into clear product strategy.
Experience working with AI researchers, ML teams, evaluation frameworks, developer tools, or human-in-the-loop data pipelines is strongly preferred.
Entrepreneurial mindset with a track record of creating new products, programs, or business initiatives from the ground up.
Bias for action and comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
Passion for advancing trustworthy AI and helping define how the industry builds and measures frontier model capabilities.
For the Coding role: strong software engineering depth, plus familiarity with how coding models are trained and evaluated (post-training methods, agentic scaffolds and harnesses, benchmarks like SWE-Bench and Terminal-Bench).
