jobs.description:
Description

What if running an e-commerce business could become dramatically simpler — with AI helping sellers manage orders, inventory, pricing and operations across every channel they sell on?

Amazon Smart Commerce is looking for a Principal Product Manager - Tech to lead SmartHub (including the team of PMs), our multi-channel commerce operations platform. SmartHub brings together orders, inventory, catalog, returns, warehousing and business insights across marketplaces and D2C channels into a single system, helping businesses operate at scale without navigating multiple disconnected tools.

We are now at an exciting inflection point. Advances in generative and agentic AI create an opportunity to fundamentally rethink how sellers operate their businesses — moving from dashboards and workflows that tell sellers what happened, toward intelligent experiences that understand their business, identify what needs attention, recommend actions and increasingly execute work on their behalf.

As the Principal PM for SmartHub, you will define this next chapter. You will own the long-term product vision and roadmap for SmartHub and lead important horizontal capabilities such as pricing that span the broader Smart Commerce portfolio.

This is a role for a product builder who enjoys solving complex platform problems, operating in ambiguity and translating emerging technology into simple products that deliver measurable customer and business impact.

Key job responsibilities

Own the product vision, strategy and roadmap for SmartHub, Amazon Smart Commerce's multi-channel operations platform spanning order management, inventory, catalog, returns, warehousing and analytics.

Define how AI and agentic experiences can transform commerce operations — helping businesses move from manually operating software toward systems that understand business context, surface opportunities and risks, recommend decisions and automate repetitive work.

Reimagine high-frequency seller workflows such as order processing, inventory management, exception handling, returns and pricing to make operating across multiple sales channels dramatically simpler.

Lead horizontal product capabilities such as pricing that can create leverage across SmartHub and the broader Smart Commerce portfolio.

Develop a deep understanding of sellers ranging from emerging businesses to high-volume brands, including the operators who use SmartHub every day in warehouses and back offices.

Use customer research, product data and business insights to identify the highest-value problems and translate them into simple, scalable product experiences.

Partner deeply with engineering, science and UX teams on complex platform and AI problems, making thoughtful trade-offs across customer experience, reliability, scalability and speed.

Define and drive metrics across adoption, engagement, operational efficiency, seller experience and business impact.

Work across Amazon and external commerce ecosystems to build integrations and capabilities that allow businesses to operate seamlessly across marketplaces and D2C channels.

Influence senior leaders and partner teams across organizational boundaries to establish long-term product and technology direction.

Raise the product management bar through strong product judgment, first-principles thinking, clear written narratives and mentorship of other product leaders.

A day in the life

You might start the day speaking with a seller or warehouse operator processing thousands of orders across Amazon, Flipkart and their own website, identifying where manual work and exceptions slow them down. Later, you could work with engineers and scientists on an AI agent that detects inventory risks or automates an operational workflow, review adoption and reliability metrics with the team, and then align senior leaders on a multi-year product strategy. You will move fluidly between warehouse-floor details, customer experience, platform architecture, AI possibilities and business strategy.

About The Team

Amazon Smart Commerce is building the technology infrastructure for agentic commerce that helps businesses sell and operate wherever their customers shop.

SmartHub is our multi-channel operations platform, helping sellers bring orders, inventory, catalog, returns and business insights from multiple marketplaces and D2C channels into one system. It is built for the operational realities of commerce — high-volume events, warehouse workflows, complex integrations and businesses that cannot afford downtime.

We believe AI creates an opportunity to reinvent this category. Our ambition is to evolve from software that helps sellers manage workflows to an intelligent commerce operating system that helps them run and grow their businesses.

Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

new_jobs.title: Director of Marketing
new_jobs.description:
Science is a clinical stage, vertically integrated technology company focused on solving some of neuroscience’s hardest questions and most serious unmet medical needs. We work to restore quality of life to those with debilitating conditions for which there are no treatment options, creating devices aimed at restoring vision, cognition, and mobility to patients who have lost it. To support progress across our industry, we provide state-of-the-art components and vertically integrated infrastructure for others to build on via Science Foundry.

This is an exciting time to join. PRIMA, our wireless subretinal implant for geographic atrophy secondary to age-related macular degeneration (AMD), was evaluated in the PRIMAvera pivotal study, published in the New England Journal of Medicine. Geographic atrophy is a leading cause of irreversible vision loss, and this role offers a rare opportunity to build the US marketing strategy for a genuinely new technology from the ground up. PRIMA is CE marked in the European Union and registered for supply in the United Kingdom and we are preparing for the US regulatory approval.

We are seeking a Marketing Director to shape and lead the US marketing strategy for PRIMA. Reporting to the Chief Communications Officer, this role will define how Science enters the market & builds awareness among our two key customer groups—healthcare providers and patients—and prepares the US market for PRIMA, subject to regulatory approval. You will develop the US market and launch strategy, positioning, and multi-year marketing plan, and oversee their delivery across professional education, congresses, digital, and patient advocacy channels. The ideal candidate has launched Class III medical devices in the US, brings deep experience in both HCP and patient marketing, and is comfortable operating in a fast-paced, pre-commercial environment. You will work closely with leaders across clinical, regulatory, medical affairs, and market access, and demonstrate commitment to Science's mission. This role is based in the United States.

Role Responsibilities

Develop and own the US marketing and launch strategy for PRIMA, including market segmentation, positioning, and a multi-year marketing plan aligned with regulatory milestones and company objectives
Define the HCP marketing strategy for retina specialists, ophthalmologists, optometrists, and referring clinicians, including messaging, value propositions, and professional education priorities
Define the patient and caregiver marketing strategy, including disease awareness, patient journey mapping, and partnerships with patient advocacy and low-vision organizations
Shape Science's US congress and medical education strategy (e.g., AAO, ASRS), ensuring communications remain scientific and non-promotional prior to FDA approval
Lead market research and competitive intelligence to build deep insight into the US geographic atrophy landscape, customer needs, and referral pathways
Partner with market access, reimbursement, and commercial leadership on launch readiness, including implanting center strategy and referral network development
Set the marketing budget, KPIs, and measurement framework; select and direct agency partners and hold them accountable for performance
Work with the Chief Communications Officer and the regulatory, legal, and medical affairs teams to ensure all communications comply with FDA requirements, including restrictions on pre-approval promotion

Key Qualifications

8+ years of marketing experience in the medical device industry, with progressive responsibility for marketing strategy
Direct experience launching one or more Class III (PMA) medical devices in the US
Proven experience developing and leading both HCP and patient (direct-to-consumer) marketing programs
Strong working knowledge of US medical device promotional regulations, including FDA restrictions on pre-approval promotion
Demonstrated ability to turn market insight into strategy and to influence senior leadership and cross-functional partners
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Life Sciences, or related field (or equivalent professional experience)

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in ophthalmology, retina, or neurotechnology markets
Experience building the market for a new-to-world technology or new treatment category
Familiarity with US reimbursement and market access considerations for implantable devices
MBA or advanced degree

Job Description

Directs teams to conduct thorough market research and analysis across diverse product portfolios, ensuring alignment with Oracle's strategic goals and continuously refining competitive strategies to lead in the marketplace. Directs teams in identifying and capitalizing on customer needs, market opportunities, and regulatory requirements. Champions internal teams in the development of problem statements and solutions. Guides the product lifecycle from planning to release and establishes long-term initiatives for evolving the product roadmap for an extensive portfolio of products/features. Establishes innovative best practices organization-wide and champions analytic framework for data-driven decision-making. Partners with key stakeholders at the executive level to define and drive product direction. Drives alignment across Lines of Business (LOB) to drive product innovation and evolution. Establishes success criteria and performance metrics (e.g., OKRs and KPIs) for multiple products and features. Provides strategic oversight to teams in customer advocacy and customer-centric approaches throughout the product lifecycle, ensuring that products are tailored to customer needs. Guides the resolution development process for complex and/or high-stakes customer issues. Guides and strategically coordinates the delivery for the field team and governs various go-to-market efforts, such as recruiting and supporting early adopters to validate and refine product solutions, developing user documentation, and product demonstrations.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Product Analysis – Market Analysis:

–Directs teams to conduct market research and analysis, enabling the organization to evaluate data patterns across diverse portfolios and prioritize initiatives with the highest strategic impact.

–Guides teams to ensure that the product portfolio aligns with Oracle's strategic objectives, continuously refining competitive strategies to lead in the marketplace.

–Governs alignment efforts that integrate customer feedback, market trends, internal stakeholder priorities, and Oracle’s long-term goals.

–Sets strategic direction for product positioning, pricing, and market strategy, ensuring Oracle's sustained leadership and innovation in the industry.

Product Analysis – Solution Identification:

–Directs teams identifying and capitalizing on customers' unmet needs, market opportunities, and/or regulatory requirements, shaping the organization's strategic direction and product portfolio.

–Champions internal teams in developing problem statements and forming hypotheses for new products, ensuring alignment with long-term customer needs, emerging market trends, and organizational goals.

–Guides solution identification processes, providing strategic oversight as needed.

–Governs the creation and maintenance of solution artifacts (e.g., regulatory requirements, functional and non-functional requirements, user documentation), offering guidance as necessary.

Product Ownership – Product Development and Road mapping:

–Guides the planning, execution, and release processes for the organization’s entire product lifecycle, ensuring alignment with the overall strategic vision.

–Establishes long-term initiatives for evolving the product roadmap for an extensive portfolio of products/features, ensuring coherence with the organization’s long-term goals.

–Advises others in establishing and developing feature requirements and resources, setting innovative best practices organization-wide.

–Collaborates with senior executive stakeholders to drive delivery excellence, maintain project timelines, and ensure success.

–Champions analytic frameworks for existing metrics (e.g., Service Requests, bugs, customer feedback, customer volumes) and data-driven decision-making to achieve optimal product development and market impact.

–Provides strategic oversight for the development and review of user stories and acceptance criteria, ensuring unparalleled product quality and customer satisfaction.

–Forecasts future needs and guides prioritization of features or experiences in the roadmap, aligning them with ambitious success criteria and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs).

Product Ownership – Product Leadership and Influence:

–Partners with key stakeholders at the executive level to drive product direction in alignment with the company's vision, business goals, and customer needs.

–Sets direction for product development to deliver exceptional customer experiences and achieve business goals aligned with Oracle's future state.

–Guides business performance and operations reviews to track progress and identify opportunities for improvement.

–Strategizes the innovation and evolution of products through identification and prioritization of new features and enhancements.

Alignment and Collaboration:

–Drives alignment across business units, ensuring strategic insights are shared effectively and communication channels are optimized at all levels.

–Reviews and influences established guidance to equip employees to proactively address and navigate complex stakeholder pushback.

–Directs the development and execution of innovative solutions tied to OKRs and KPIs, driving organizational transformation.

–Establishes success criteria and performance metrics (OKRs, KPIs) for multiple products and features, ensuring alignment with the organization’s strategic vision.

–Governs cross-team user testing and iterative development, using user insights to drive innovation and leadership.

Customer-Centricity:

–Provides strategic oversight to teams advocating for customers, ensuring feedback is a critical part of the product lifecycle and overall business strategy.

–Empowers employees to engage effectively with customers, gather actionable feedback, and utilize analytics to inform strategic decision-making and improve Oracle’s offerings.

–Leads teams in adopting a customer-centric approach to identify, prioritize, and execute enhancements that provide transformative business value.

–Forecasts new product capabilities and feature designs, leveraging deep customer insights and market trends.

–Champions alignment between products and customer needs, leading initiatives to continuously adapt to, and anticipate, market shifts.

–Coordinates cross-functional collaboration, maximizing product consumer satisfaction and product success.

–Provides oversight on resolving complex and high-stakes customer issues, ensuring customer satisfaction and product quality.

Product Release – Go-to-Market:

–Guides the review, validation, and strategic coordination of delivery for the field team (e.g., release overview, field presentations, demos).

–Governs the process of recruiting and supporting early adopters to validate and refine product solutions, offering strategic oversight as needed.

–Directs development of user documentation to ensure accuracy and alignment across the organization.

–Performs high-level review of the product adoption tracking process, ensuring improvement initiatives align with long-term strategic goals.

–Guides product demonstrations for customers, partners, industry analysts, and field, engaging key stakeholders to gather feedback.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

–Provides strategic oversight in managing and executing large-scale projects or initiatives, monitoring timelines, deliverables, and budgets to ensure success.

–Sets strategies for delegation, priority setting, and aligning projects with business needs.

–Drives the strategic planning process across teams, providing guidance on resource allocation and anticipating changes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

–Sets strategic direction for collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of expectations and objectives.

–Drives a culture of teamwork, empowering teams to build and maintain partnerships with business leaders, stakeholders, and customers for organizational success.

–Promotes transparency and inclusivity so that all voices are valued and respected.

Problem Solving:

–Develops and implements organizational strategies for advanced problem-solving, serving as an escalation point for highly complex operational or technical issues.

–Oversees teams leveraging innovative techniques to tackle ambiguous issues and identifies root causes to prevent recurrence, reviewing solutions as needed.

Continuous Learning:

–Champions continuous learning to maintain cutting-edge skills and organizational best practices.

–Inspires teams to maintain expertise by monitoring trends, technologies, and standards, positioning Oracle as an industry leader.

–Contributes to strategy for learning and development, influencing leadership to foster opportunities for growth.

Continuous Improvement:

–Drives a culture of improvement, establishing efficient and effective processes, protocols, and workflows across the organization.

–Oversees efforts to implement large-scale improvements, ensuring alignment with goals.

–Sets direction, prioritizes, and approves the roadmap of initiatives to maximize return on investment.

Performance and Development:

new_jobs.title: Director, Growth and Subscriptions
new_jobs.description:
Yahoo Finance is the world’s #1 finance destination, empowering investors with news, information, and tools to make financial decisions with confidence. Trusted by over 150M visitors globally each month, representing over $20 trillion dollars in investable assets, Yahoo Finance delivers high-quality real-time market data across desktop, mobile, and streaming platforms. With breaking news from thousands of sources, original editorial perspectives, objective analyst ratings and research, analytical charts and technical tools, personalized mobile alerts, and much more, Yahoo Finance equips investors with knowledge and insights to achieve financial freedom and greater prosperity.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Director of Growth & Subscriptions to own growth across the full Yahoo Finance product portfolio: Content, Data and Portfolios, AlphaSpace and Premium subscriptions, and for future Yahoo Finance product features and releases. This is a senior leadership role with two mandates: 1. Drive subscription growth for Yahoo Finance +, and 2. Drive adoption and usage across all Yahoo Finance products. You'll have a clear view of how our users discover, adopt, and engage with our products, and how we convert the most passionate ones into paying subscribers. You'll work closely with Marketing, Technology, Content & Editorial, and Business to make that happen.

The Details

Portfolio Growth & Engagement

Yahoo Finance: Drive usage, retention, and re-engagement across all Yahoo Finance product surfaces.
Portfolios and Watchlists: Grow adoption of features like Portfolios, Watchlists, analysis, stock quote pages and “Ask Scout” - all experiences that deepen the Yahoo Finance relationship with our customers.
Content & Editorial: Partner with Content to grow high-engagement surfaces and ensure new editorial products reach and retain the right audiences.
New Product Launches: Own the growth playbook for every major product or feature we ship, from adoption targets to in-product onboarding and feedback loops.

Subscription Business Growth

In-product conversion: Build upgrade flows, manage paywall placement, and merchandising across Yahoo Finance product surfaces including AlphaSpace, our new tool for active investors.
Onboarding & activation: Demonstrate value to new subscribers fast through tool adoption, engagement habits, and early retention.
Subscriber retention: Own renewal optimization, churn-save mechanics, and re-engagement
In-product virality: Build referral loops and sharing mechanics that turn engaged subscribers into a growth channel.
Partner perks & benefits: Manage the Finance+ Premium Perks program across perk value, partner relationships, and subscriber-exclusive offers.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Partner closely with Marketing on go-to-market strategy for new products and Finance+, from launch positioning to campaigns and subscriber retention.
Collaborate with Technology and Engineering to ensure growth and engagement are built into the product from day one, not bolted on after launch.
Work with Content & Editorial to build high-engagement experiences and subscriber-exclusive programming
Partner with Business Development on perks, affiliate relationships, and partnerships that increase Finance+ value.
Bring a data-informed point of view to the GM and executive team on engagement trends, subscription performance, and trade-offs.
Build a culture of ownership, experimentation, and accountability across the teams you work with. Move fast, learn, and ship.

Required

What We're Looking For

10+ years in product management or growth, with meaningful time in consumer-facing, high-scale digital products.
Track record driving user engagement, adoption, and retention across a portfolio of products, not just a single funnel.
Experience operating a subscription or D2C business with revenue accountability across conversion, activation, and retention.
Strong command of in-product growth: onboarding flows, engagement loops, A/B experimentation, and paywall mechanics.
Enough product sense to work with engineering as a peer. You know what to ask for and what it costs.
Strong analytical instincts: comfortable building dashboards, reasoning from cohort data, and changing course when the data says to.
Proven cross-functional leader who can drive outcomes across teams you don't control.

Preferred

Experience in finance, investment products, personal finance or fintech with a genuine affinity for finance and investing.
Experience growing data-centered products like banking, stocks, and investing
Familiarity with low-cost, high-engagement B2C subscription economics.

new_jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Search Monetization
new_jobs.description:
Yahoo serves as a trusted guide for hundreds of millions of people globally, helping them achieve their goals online through our portfolio of iconic products. For advertisers, Yahoo Advertising offers omnichannel solutions and powerful data to engage with our brands and deliver results.

Director, Product Management, Search Monetization

A Little About Us

Yahoo Search helps millions of people find information, answers, products, services, and inspiration across the web. The Search Product team is building the next generation of Yahoo Search, evolving both our traditional search results experience and new AI-powered experiences such as Scout.

Monetization is a critical part of that future. Our team is responsible for creating advertising experiences that deliver strong value for users, advertisers, and Yahoo. We work at the intersection of consumer experience, advertising technology, machine learning, data science, and business strategy, with an opportunity to both optimize a scaled existing business and define entirely new monetization models for AI-powered search.

About The Role

We are seeking a Director of Product Management, Search Monetization
to own product strategy and execution for monetization across Yahoo Search.

This is a senior individual contributor role
for a hands-on product leader with deep experience in sponsored search and search advertising. You will be responsible for improving the performance of advertising across our search results pages while protecting and improving the overall user experience. You will also help define the future of monetization for AI-powered Search, including Scout, developing new ad products and commercial experiences that feel native to how people discover information and make decisions in conversational and generative experiences.

This role combines optimization and invention. You will work deeply on ad relevance, ranking, placement, density, query coverage, marketplace dynamics, and experimentation, while also identifying and developing entirely new advertising concepts and business models.

You will partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Design, Research, Business Development, Finance, and other Product teams. Because Yahoo works with external advertising marketplaces and technology partners, you will also play an important role in defining product requirements, identifying opportunities, and working across partner ecosystems to improve monetization outcomes.

We are looking for someone who can move comfortably between strategy and execution: defining where Search monetization should go, digging into performance data to understand why RPM moved, working with engineers and data scientists on optimization opportunities, and developing new ideas for how advertising can create value in the next generation of Search.

Responsibilities

Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for monetization across Yahoo Search, spanning traditional search results pages and emerging AI-powered Search experiences.
Drive meaningful improvements in Search revenue and RPM while maintaining clear user experience guardrails and high standards for ad quality and relevance.
Optimize sponsored search across ad relevance, ranking, placement, density, presentation, query coverage, and other product and marketplace levers, including expanding monetizable query coverage where appropriate.
Define and build a scalable monetization model for Scout and other AI-powered Search experiences, inventing, prototyping, testing, and scaling new advertising formats and commercial experiences for generative, conversational, and agentic interactions.
Modernize Yahoo Search's approach to ad optimization, partnering with Engineering and Data Science on ranking systems, machine learning models, decisioning systems, experimentation capabilities, and supporting platform investments.
Develop a deep understanding of Search monetization performance, using statistical analysis, experimentation, marketplace data, and user behavior to diagnose opportunities and prioritize investments.
Design and interpret experiments in complex advertising marketplace environments, including situations where traditional experimentation is constrained by marketplace dynamics, partner systems, auction effects, or limited traffic.
Establish success metrics and measurement frameworks that balance revenue, RPM, advertiser value, ad relevance, engagement, query coverage, and user experience.
Partner closely with external advertising and technology partners, as well as Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and Design, to identify opportunities, define requirements, troubleshoot performance, launch new experiences, and move products from concept through scaled launch.
Develop a strong understanding of advertiser needs, marketplace dynamics, competitive trends, and emerging advertising models, translating those insights into new product opportunities and clearly communicating strategy, performance, and tradeoffs to senior leaders.

Minimum Qualifications

9+ years of Product Management or equivalent experience, including significant experience building and optimizing advertising or monetization products at scale.
5+ years of direct experience with search advertising, sponsored search, or closely related performance advertising products, with a strong understanding of search intent, ad relevance, advertiser value, and user experience.
Demonstrated success improving scaled advertising or monetization products through optimization, experimentation, and data-driven decision making, with strong knowledge of ad ranking, relevance, placement, coverage, yield, and marketplace dynamics.
Experience working with programmatic advertising marketplaces, external ad platforms, advertising partners, or similar multi-party ecosystems.
Strong analytical and quantitative skills, including experience interpreting statistical analyses, marketplace data, large-scale product metrics, and experiments in environments where traditional A/B testing may have limitations.
Technical fluency sufficient to work deeply with engineers and data scientists on machine learning models, ranking and decisioning systems, experimentation frameworks, data pipelines, and system architecture.
Strong product judgment and user empathy, with demonstrated ability to balance monetization and consumer experience while translating ambiguous commercial opportunities into product concepts, hypotheses, experiments, and roadmaps.
Ability to operate as a highly autonomous, hands-on senior individual contributor, moving fluidly between strategy and detailed execution and communicating complex product, technical, and business tradeoffs to senior leaders and cross-functional partners.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience owning monetization for a large-scale consumer search, commerce, marketplace, or discovery product.
Experience building or optimizing advertising products powered by machine learning, relevance models, recommendation systems, auction systems, or marketplace technology.
Experience developing new advertising formats or monetization models, including for AI-powered, conversational, generative, recommendation, or agentic consumer experiences.
Experience working across multiple external advertising or technology partners where product performance depends on systems outside your direct ownership.
Familiarity with advertiser economics, auction dynamics, conversion measurement, attribution, and other components of the advertising ecosystem.
A track record of identifying non-obvious monetization opportunities and turning them into products that create meaningful value for users, advertisers, and the business, including using AI-assisted tools for analysis, ideation, prototyping, or product discovery.

Description

Amazon Global Logistics (AGL) empowers hundreds of thousands of Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) sellers and other business customers with reliable, cross-border freight solutions — moving billions of products via ocean and air freight through the Amazon Fulfillment Network worldwide. We combine the scale of Amazon's global logistics network with real-time shipment visibility and seamless seller integration to deliver dependable, end-to-end supply chain solutions.

As Principal Product Manager for New & Emerging Geographies, you will launch new global cross-border origin-to-destination arcs and grow existing ones. You will own the product vision and roadmap with broad cross-organizational influence. This is a strategic, high-visibility, high-impact role at a pivotal moment for AGL — as we grow our product for businesses of all types amidst shifting global policies that are redefining how sellers move inventory at scale.

Key job responsibilities

Use customer insights and metrics to define product vision and the feature backlog
Work with finance, pricing, and operations to manage the P&L for each geographic arc
Drive growth performance accountability in business reviews using data analytics
Work with sales, marketing, business development, and operations on go-to-market strategy
Influence broad organizational direction through well-formed narratives and high-visibility leadership reviews
Navigate ambiguity across organizations to drive a unified global strategy

A day in the life

Your day will be a blend of data-driven decision-making, cross-functional collaboration, and leadership reviews. You will spend time gathering data and customer anecdotes to define a product strategy. You'll write documents to define your vision, while influencing across the broader product organization to ensure the most critical initiatives are prioritized. Expect to collaborate with marketing, sales, engineering, finance, and business intelligence partners to define product roadmaps, analyze data sets, and make impactful decisions that directly influence global logistics operations.

About The Team

The Global Logistics Imports team sits at the intersection of product, supply chain, and global operations. We are a fast-paced, globally distributed team that moves quickly, thinks big, and holds ourselves to a high bar. We value intellectual curiosity, strong ownership, and the ability to simplify complex problems into clear, actionable strategies. If you thrive in ambiguous environments and want your work to directly impact how hundreds of thousands of sellers grow their businesses on Amazon, this is the team for you.

new_jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Leo is building the world's most advanced Low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite constellation to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the globe. As part of this mission, we are seeking a Principal Product Manager – Technical (PMT) to define product requirements, lead feature alignment, and drive roadmap planning for the NTN Core Network globally. You will work closely with engineering teams across satellite RAN, Core, and Devices, with focus on the NTN core.

This role requires deep technical mastery of 3GPP protocols, NAS signaling, extensive experience deploying 4G/5G Packet Cores across multiple vendors, product lifecycle software release management, and the ability to translate customer experiences and user stories into detailed product requirements. The Principal Product Manager - Technical (PMT) will be at the forefront of defining NTN Core Network requirements and building 0-to-1 satellite systems for consumer, business, and government customers globally.

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities

Drive NTN Core Network feature alignment to ensure interoperability across Amazon Leo RAN, Core, Transport, and cloud infrastructure, delivering seamless connectivity and roaming services between satellite and terrestrial networks.
Own the NTN Core Network product roadmap and service delivery plan, ensuring delivery across multiple workstreams with high standards and operational excellence.
Work closely with Amazon Leo engineering teams, Payload Integration Test (PIT) and telco MNO/Device/Chipset partners to define, build, deploy and test 3GPP-compliant protocol layers, network functions, and service-based architecture, ensuring deterministic behavior, low latency, and high reliability for satellite-based connectivity and TN-NTN mobility. Lead by example with systems thinking to solve problems.
Stay current with 3GPP releases, industry trends, and evolving NTN deployment models to guide long-term product strategy aligned to Amazon Leo’s roadmap.
Write and present technical documents (6-pagers, PR/FAQs, BRDs, PRDs) to senior leadership.
Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering hardware, software, systems, operations, and program management teams across Amazon Leo.
Be structured and flexible at the same time to learn as the business evolves.
Provide visibility and communicate extremely well, with responsibility to provide updates to VPs, author operation plans, business review documents, and communicate to the broader Amazon Leo team.
Be a seasoned product leader with a demonstrated history of leading product strategy, technology solutions, data analytics, and customer experience.
Thrive on ambiguity and have a track record of delivering large-scale technology products and/or led large operational or technical teams.
Lead large, global, and complex technology initiatives in a large business unit, working cross-functionally with several business and technical teams.
The ability to think and move quickly and is inspired to build mechanisms to simplify and continuously innovate.
Demonstrated analytical and quantitative skills; ability to use hard data and metrics to back up assumptions and develop business cases.

Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious and earn trust.

You will be joining a team that is focused on defining and driving the product requirements for the Amazon Leo Direct-to-Device (DTD) satellite system.

Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
Experience technical product management

10+ years of solving problems with technology in the Telecommunications industry experience

Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement

Experience working with and influencing senior level stakeholders

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is building developer tool products that help engineering teams create software with greater speed, quality, and confidence. This role will focus on the Develop phase of the software development lifecycle, with a major emphasis on improving the developer experience across planning, coding, collaboration, code review, testing, debugging, documentation, onboarding, and service comprehension.

We are seeking a Principal Product Manager to lead product strategy and execution for OCI Developer Tool Products focused on how OCI customers and internal engineering teams use modern cloud-native and AI-native tools to develop, release, and operate software more effectively.

A central part of this role will be helping development teams transition to AI-native software development practices. You will identify where AI can meaningfully reduce friction, improve productivity, raise code quality, accelerate onboarding, and help developers better understand complex systems. You will work closely with engineering, UX, platform teams, security, compliance, and customers to define product direction, prioritize high-impact investments, and deliver tools that make development more intuitive, efficient, and intelligent.

Experience working with engineering teams on technically complex products and translating developer needs into clear product requirements, roadmaps, and execution plans

Experience with security, compliance, governance, or audit requirements in enterprise development workflows

A Little About Us

The Yahoo DSP Research team sits at the core of our programmatic ad platform, developing the mathematical models and algorithms that govern billions of dollars in real-time ad spend daily. We blend control theory, machine learning, and economics with modern AI-driven engineering practices to build world-class marketplace optimization systems.

About The Role

As a Principal Research Scientist (IC6) on the Yahoo DSP Optimization team, you will serve as a primary technical authority driving the next-generation architecture for budget control, pacing, and bidding algorithms. In this role, you will lead the evolution of our high-scale optimization stack by integrating agentic AI practices—shifting traditional research-to-production pipelines into highly automated, AI-augmented development loops.

Responsibilities

Lead the research, architectural design, and production deployment of large-scale algorithms for budget pacing, bid optimization, and marketplace supply/demand balancing.
Architect and spearhead the implementation of agentic AI workflows—utilizing AI coding agents, automated experiment orchestration, and agent-driven validation to dramatically accelerate research-to-production iteration velocity.
Provide technical strategy and long-term vision for the DSP optimization ecosystem in close alignment with business and engineering leadership.
Apply control theory, convex/stochastic optimization, and machine learning to solve complex, real-time marketplace dynamics under signal uncertainty.
Direct AI-assisted code refactoring, automated testing suite generation, and LLM-driven research synthesis using modern tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT) to elevate team engineering standards.
Own multi-quarter research initiatives from mathematical formulation through production rollout, establishing rigorous metrics and evaluation frameworks.
Partner closely with engineering and product management teams to ensure algorithmic designs execute seamlessly at scale.
Mentor senior scientists and engineers, setting technical excellence standards and fostering an AI-forward research culture.
Communicate technical strategy, experimental results, and architectural choices clearly to executive and cross-functional partners.

Basic Qualifications

Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Operations Research, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
8+ years of hands-on experience designing and deploying large-scale optimization, control systems, or machine learning models in production environments.
Deep mathematical foundation in probability, convex/stochastic optimization, and control theory (e.g., feedback control, model predictive control).

new_jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Ads operates at the intersection of eCommerce and advertising, offering a rich array of digital display advertising solutions with the goal of helping our customers find and discover anything they want to buy. We help advertisers reach Amazon customers on Amazon.com, across our other owned and operated sites, on other high-quality sites across the web, and on millions of Kindles, tablets, and mobile devices. We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do, including advertising. If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing team working to build a unique, world-class advertising group with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.

Amazon Ads is looking for a Senior Product Release Manager, Global Release Management to lead release management globally for advertising products, tools and services that impact all Amazon advertisers and customers. As our ad products evolve, the Release Management team's core function is to ensure all internal services teams are systematically equipped to support advertisers be successful with our products. Beyond release planning and launch risk mitigation to protect the advertiser and customer experience, Release Management focuses on delivering operational simplification of products through upstream prioritization of features that enable effective, self-service execution for users. Release Managers build scalable processes and mechanisms with up and downstream stakeholders in order to launch, and maintain successful ad products.

The candidate will have high standards for themselves and everyone they work with, and will be constantly looking around corners to prevent short-sighted decisions. This role requires a strong ability to find creative solutions to challenging problems, excellent communication skills, ability to easily navigate ambiguity and define a path forward. You must know how to influence and motivate to get the right things done.

Key job responsibilities

While Product Managers drive product vision and technical requirements; Release Managers provide data-driven cross-product business understanding of releases impact and success. They drive shared goals and gain investments prioritization alignment. Lastly, Release Managers are excellent at driving results, able to coordinate large, multi-functional projects on-time, anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, make trade-offs, and balance business needs versus technical constraints. They are involved in reviewing product workflow design and balance near term business need with longer term implications for Amazon. They rationalize business priorities and technical requirements with cross-functional teams, effectively managing cross-functional communication to ensure all business and technical stakeholder’s needs are aligned.

This is a multi-faceted role requiring a breadth of skills and expertise:

Engage with global stakeholders to understand priorities, and drive cross-team initiatives
Identify scaled opportunities to help partners implement readiness solutions that expedite market launches and improve product performance
Track program(s) health and success by evaluating performance and deriving insights via structured analyses in order to influence strategic decisions

A day in the life

Sr. Product Release Managers lead product releases that are large in scope and impact to customers and to the advertising business. They are expected to influence product development strategy to launch the right advertising solutions for advertisers. They enable optimal business and investments decisions for upstream and downstream executing teams through providing data and insights that help identify opportunities for product automation and improved CX. Beyond RM responsibilities, they autonomously gain partner buy-in and implement mechanisms that raise the release readiness bar for all advertising Products and tools globally. They independently develop roadmaps, project plans, risks and dependency logs, releases planning calendars, status updates, and post-mortems. They build simplified processes that automate repeatable activities, promote global standardization, improve testing rigor, remove internal process bottlenecks, and drive productivity gains. They leverage their expertise of operational processes and their deep understanding of product architecture to influence prioritization of product requirements.

About The Team

Senior Product Release Managers leverage user workflow and services expertise to enable ad products innovation into Advertiser experiences that scale. Release Management works at the intersection of ad product and services to simplify and improve products and tools, accelerating progress toward issue-free self-service solutions. RM owns critical business functions within CCS; 1) providing design and operational product requirement guidance for product prioritization, 2) mitigating launch impacts across services teams, 3) enabling a common business understanding of product growth and business opportunity vs. execution and CX risks, 4) managing user acceptance testing (UAT), and lastly, 5) driving ongoing open product issue resolution. The RM team acts as the guardrail for the end-to-end user and advertiser experience successfully creating and managing ad campaigns. As the strategic bi-directional voice between Product and Service organizations, RMs have a broad scope of product knowledge, from a deep understanding of their ad product portfolio to end-to-end systems, back-end data flows, and user experience. RMs influence at all levels without authority by acting as the voice of the product customer (internal and advertiser) and shopper customer.

Basic Qualifications

Strong program management and analytical skills, be comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and have the ability to effectively influence and communicate with global stakeholders
Proven ability to think and move quickly and manage difficult tradeoffs to meet deadlines
Experience in strategy, change management, release management and rolling-out large scale initiatives
Experience executing both strategic and operational initiatives
Experience planning, scheduling, implementing projects in a demanding, change-oriented, fast-paced environment requiring a high degree of deadline-driven productivity
Proven ability to work with team members to design scalable processes, implement strategic projects that solve business problems, with focus on continuous improvement
Ability to lead and work effectively with cross functional groups
Excellent communication (verbal and written) and collaboration skills that enable you to earn trust at all levels, including senior leadership
Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with digital advertising and ad serving
Working knowledge of Amazon DSP

⠀

About Metagenics

For over 43 years, Metagenics has had the mission to help people live happier, healthier lives through the life-changing power of nutrition.

We believe the way we do business is as important as the business we do; that a company in the nourishment business should nourish its people, too. So, we incorporated healthy, sustainable care into every dimension of our culture. Our diverse and expansive team are a prime example of the power of a people-first approach. We know first-hand, when an organization prioritizes internal growth and fosters empathy, its people come together to set an example of what the world can become.

Join us in being the world’s leading healthcare professional-grade VMS company!

⠀

The Role

Metagenics is investing meaningfully in the modernization and convergence of its global technology stack. Over the next several years we will unify our enterprise systems, modernize our commerce and integration architecture, scale a portfolio of production AI programs, and evolve toward a Centers of Excellence operating

model.

To do this well, we need a Principal Solution Architect who can hold the whole picture — the systems, the data, the integrations, the security posture, the operational readiness — and set the technical direction that our teams and delivery partners execute against.

This is a highly visible role, working directly with the CTO, technology leadership, and executive stakeholders across the business. You will become the enterprise’s technical center of gravity.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture Strategy and Standards

Own the enterprise reference architecture across ERP, ecommerce, data, integration, and AI layers
Set architectural patterns, standards, and technology selection criteria that every technology function executes against
Chair the Architecture Review Board and sign off on architecturally significant decisions

Cross-functional Technical Direction

Serve as the peer-level technical advisor to each area leader across ERP, Ecommerce, Data & AI, Security, and IT Operations
Ensure major transformation programs share consistent integration, data, identity, and observability patterns
Prevent point solutions from calcifying into new legacy

Enterprise Transformation Architecture

Own the target-state architecture for our global ERP consolidation onto a single modern platform
Own the target-state architecture for our global ecommerce convergence — including B2C, B2B / practitioner, subscriptions, payments, tax, and fulfillment
Own the platform architecture for our generative AI programs — including LLM routing, retrieval patterns, data pipelines, guardrails, and observability

Middleware and Integration

Rearchitect middleware and integrations across disparate enterprise systems — evolve a large point-to-point integration estate into a governed, event-driven architecture
Set the strategic direction for the enterprise integration platform, ensuring it simplifies as major systems converge
Establish clean separation of concerns — no business logic living in middleware where it doesn’t belong

Data

Define the enterprise data architecture — master data, event streams, warehousing, and downstream consumption for BI, AI, and operational reporting
Establish clean ownership between the transactional stack and the analytical / AI stack

Security, Compliance, and Resilience

Partner with the Head of Security on architecture-level controls — identity, access, data classification, encryption, network segmentation
Ensure compliance with applicable regimes including NIS2, FSSC 22000, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and regional privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA)
Design for resilience — RTO/RPO targets, disaster recovery patterns, and business continuity

What You'll Need

Experience / Training / Education

15+ years in enterprise technology, with at least 5 years as a senior or principal-level architect at a global company
Direct hands-on architectural experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Finance & Operations and/or Customer Engagement) at scale — including multi-country / multi-legal-entity deployments
Direct experience architecting modern ecommerce platforms — Shopify strongly preferred; comparable modern commerce platforms also considered
Deep understanding of integration architecture — iPaaS platforms, event-driven patterns, API-first design
Experience architecting modern data platforms — Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Databricks, or comparable
Working knowledge of generative AI architecture — RAG, agent patterns, LLM routing, evals, and guardrails

Preferred Experience

Consumer goods, life sciences, or regulated food / manufacturing industry background
Direct experience with NIS2, FSSC 22000, ISO 27001, SOC 2 compliance regimes
Experience with practitioner or healthcare-professional channels and the pricing, payment, and rebate models that come with them
Prior experience standing up or scaling a Center of Excellence operating model

You'll Love This Job If You're

A systems thinker — able to hold the whole picture without losing sight of the seams
Decisive and pragmatic — comfortable making calls with incomplete data and revisiting them cleanly when evidence changes
Comfortable influencing at the executive level — you can carry a technical argument into a senior leadership or board conversation without losing the audience
A builder, not just a governor — you ship reference implementations, not just publish diagrams
A coach and multiplier — you make the architects and engineers around you better

based in Jersey City, New Jersey is $180,000/yr. to $218,000/yr.

Responsibilities:

Leads and develops a team of product management professionals responsible for the commercial performance and strategic direction of assigned aerospace product families
Develops and executes product strategies, including portfolio positioning, value-based pricing frameworks and commercialization plans to drive revenue growth and long-term profitability
Analyzes product line financial performance, including revenue, profitability, and product mix; recommends actions to improve commercial performance and long-term portfolio health
Partners with engineering, operations, finance, and sales leadership to ensure alignment between product strategy, manufacturing capabilities and customer requirements across global aerospace platforms and customer programs
Coordinates with manufacturing sites to ensure product strategies align with operational capabilities, capacity planning and long-term production requirements
Identifies and evaluates accretive product opportunities through market analysis, competitive intelligence and customer engagement; prepares business cases and strategic proposals for management review
Leads the cross-functional development and launch of new products, including evaluation of technical feasibility, cost structures, market demand and long-term profitability potential
Establishes pricing strategies and policies for assigned product lines, ensuring alignment with value delivered, competitive dynamics and business profitability objectives
Develops and maintains structured pricing frameworks, including automated price lists, pricing governance processes and pricing analytics to support consistent value-based pricing across product families
Monitors product performance across the lifecycle, identifying opportunities to improve revenue, profitability, operational efficiency and customer value
Maintains close engagement with key aerospace customers and outside sales teams to monitor market trends, program developments and evolving customer requirements
Facilitates site-level revenue planning and develops market outlooks in conjunction with the commercial organization to support business planning and capacity planning across product lines
Provides strategic recommendations to senior leadership regarding product portfolio investment, market expansion opportunities and long-term growth initiatives.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, economics, supply chain, and/or related discipline roles, preferably within aerospace or industrial manufacturing
Minimum 2 years of leading a team with direct reports
Employees must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree (MBA or related) preferred
Strong understanding of aerospace manufacturing environments, including production processes, cost structures, and capacity planning considerations
Experience developing and implementing value-based pricing strategies, structured price lists, and pricing governance frameworks across product portfolios
Demonstrated ability to evaluate market opportunities and competitive positioning, supporting business cases and strategic proposals for new products or portfolio investments
Experience supporting annual revenue planning, market size projection, and product portfolio investment decisions

new_jobs.description:
Description

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

The Agentic WorkSpaces organization envisions a world where people teams and AI collaborate securely from anywhere to create unprecedented value for every organization. We build lovable products that empower every business to unlock the full potential of human-AI teamwork driving smarter decisions greater creativity more value and faster innovation with confidence. This vision is realized through the agentic WorkSpace - a secure managed environment purpose-built for human-AI collaboration at enterprise scale where people and AI agents work side by side to deliver results neither could achieve alone.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to own End-User Experience across the Agentic WorkSpaces portfolio.

This is a strategic portfolio-level role focused on defining how people and AI agents experience interact with and derive value from our products. You will establish the end-user experience strategy principles and measurable bar across a set of products that span today's human-centered virtual desktop experiences emerging in-product agentic assistance and future fully agentic workloads. You will define the experience paradigms for agentic WorkSpaces across the full spectrum of use cases: human workloads in-app agents that assist people in completing work and headless or autonomous agentic workloads that operate on behalf of users or businesses. You will ensure that agentic interfaces are cohesive across the portfolio that product teams are building from a common set of tenets and guidelines and that the human experience becomes richer and simpler as AI capabilities expand rather than more fragmented or complex.

Key job responsibilities

: In this role you will develop a deep understanding of our end-user personas their work patterns and the industry contexts in which they operate. You will clarify how the needs of a call center agent differ from those of an engineer how a financial advisor's workflow differs from a contractor's and how autonomous AI agents introduce entirely new experience requirements. You will identify the patterns that cut across personas and industries distinguish them from requirements that are truly unique and translate those insights into product direction that individual teams can adopt and execute. You will partner closely with engineering design product go-to-market and product marketing to shape roadmaps influence product decisions and ensure that end-user experience is treated as a strategic differentiator across the organization. You will also own the KPIs that define whether we are delivering a world-class end-user experience. You will establish the right measures of usability adoption productivity agent effectiveness user trust task completion and business value. You will identify where our products fall short raise the bar across teams and drive the changes needed to close those gaps.
The ideal candidate is both strategic and deeply customer obsessed. They are curious about how people work how AI agents will change work and how enterprise products must evolve as human and agentic workflows converge. They can move comfortably from customer conversations to product principles from ambiguous future-state thinking to near-term execution and from portfolio-level strategy to the details that determine whether a product feels intuitive trustworthy and indispensable. This is an opportunity to define the end-user experience for a new category of enterprise product: one where humans and AI agents collaborate securely at scale. The person in this role will help shape not just individual features but the experience model product bar and operating principles that guide Agentic WorkSpaces as the portfolio evolves.

About The Team

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. new_jobs.title: Senior AI Product Manager
new_jobs.description:
Scale has been the leading AI data foundry, helping fuel the most exciting advancements in AI, including frontier model training, enterprise adoption, defense applications, and autonomous vehicles. Our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions.

Scale's evaluation and data products shape how the industry trains and measures frontier models. Our benchmarks and leaderboards influence model development and purchasing decisions across the AI ecosystem, and our data and environments help leading labs build what comes next.

These roles are deeply cross-functional. You will work across AI Product Management, ML Research, Engineering, Operations, and Go-To-Market teams, and directly with frontier AI labs and enterprise customers, representing Scale as a thought leader in how models are trained and measured. Whichever portfolio you own, you will own it end-to-end: strategy, roadmap, infrastructure, governance, customer adoption, and business impact.

PMs here operate with significant autonomy, ship frequently, and are expected to be deeply analytical and hands-on. The ideal candidate combines strong product judgment, technical fluency, operational rigor, and customer-facing experience, with a passion for turning emerging model capabilities into scalable products.

Open Roles

Senior AI PM, Coding: Own Scale's Coding portfolio, built on SWE-Bench Pro (which cut frontier scores from 70%+ to roughly 23%), SWE Atlas, and our FrontierBench contributions. You'll decide what comes next as agents saturate current tasks, and turn that benchmark credibility into revenue from SFT and preference data, RL environments, and agentic coding evals. You'll also own the coding infrastructure roadmap and our expert network of professional software engineers. This role requires hands-on software engineering depth.
Senior AI PM, Leaderboards: Own and scale the SEAL Leaderboard portfolio across all of Scale's domains, turning cutting-edge evals into trusted industry benchmarks. You'll run the Leaderboard Steering Committee, decide which leaderboards get built, and set governance standards for evaluation integrity and release cadence. This is a horizontal role, so breadth across evaluation categories and a strong public-facing presence matter more than depth in any one domain.

You Will

Own the roadmap and strategy for your portfolio, setting priorities across product development, launches, infrastructure investments, and expansion.
Drive alignment across AI-PM, ML, Engineering, Operations, and GTM stakeholders.
Evaluate, prioritize, and operationalize new product proposals, making sure they align with customer demand, model capability frontiers, and company strategy.
Define and manage the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and design to launch, scaling, maintenance, and sunset decisions.
Partner with ML researchers and domain experts to develop trustworthy evaluation methodologies, task specifications, scoring and grader design, and quality bars.
Drive the roadmap for infrastructure, automation, and operational tooling to improve scalability, reduce manual effort, and accelerate delivery.
Establish governance processes for quality, evaluation integrity, contamination prevention, reproducibility, auditability, and release management.
Work directly with frontier AI labs and enterprise customers to understand where their models fail, gather feedback, and shape future investments.
Track adoption, usage, model impact, and business outcomes, using data to guide roadmap decisions and resource allocation.
Identify new capability areas and product opportunities that strengthen Scale's leadership and create new revenue.
Collaborate closely with GTM on customer engagements, thought leadership, product launches, and strategic partnerships.

Ideally, You'd Have

5+ years of experience in product management, technical program management, consulting, or customer-facing technical roles.
Strong technical fluency with machine learning systems, AI model evaluation, benchmarking, or data products.
Experience building and scaling products that require coordination across engineering, operations, and business teams.
Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with a proven ability to drive alignment across cross-functional organizations.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate ambiguous market and customer signals into clear product strategy.
Experience working with AI researchers, ML teams, evaluation frameworks, developer tools, or human-in-the-loop data pipelines is strongly preferred.
Entrepreneurial mindset with a track record of creating new products, programs, or business initiatives from the ground up.
Bias for action and comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.
Passion for advancing trustworthy AI and helping define how the industry builds and measures frontier model capabilities.
For the Coding role: strong software engineering depth, plus familiarity with how coding models are trained and evaluated (post-training methods, agentic scaffolds and harnesses, benchmarks like SWE-Bench and Terminal-Bench).

new_jobs.title: Director, Portfolio & Monetization Architecture
new_jobs.description:
Spotify's growth depends on offering the right thing to the right listener at the right price, moving beyond one-size-fits-all packaging toward a portfolio where listeners can mix and match what they value most. The evolution of our subscription portfolio, and how we monetize it, is one of Spotify’s most important strategic opportunities in the years ahead.

We’re looking for a Director to lead the strategic design of that portfolio end to end, shaping the architecture of tiers, add-ons, bundles, and the broader pricing ecosystem. This role will help define how the portfolio works today and how it evolves over the coming years to better serve listeners while driving sustainable growth.

As the strategic engine behind our portfolio architecture, you’ll combine commercial intuition, consumer understanding, behavioral data, and real-world market signals to build conviction behind critical decisions. Working closely with cross-functional partners and senior leaders, you’ll help determine what belongs in Premium, what moves into new monetization layers, and how Spotify’s subscription offering continues to evolve for millions of listeners around the world.

What You'll Do

Own the architecture of Spotify’s subscription portfolio, including tier structure, add-ons, bundles, and how features are allocated across them.
Set the logic of the price ladder, including relative pricing, upgrade paths, and how regional ladders work across developed and emerging markets.
Drive the insight agenda with Consumer Insights and Analytics, shaping hypotheses, sequencing research, and translating findings into clear portfolio strategy recommendations.
Partner with GTM Enablement and cross-functional teams to design, read, and apply in-market tests that connect consumer research with real behavior.
Build the business case for portfolio decisions, including sizing, contribution logic, trade-offs, and long-term commercial impact.
Drive alignment across Product, Finance, Pricing, Legal, Licensing, and senior leadership on key architecture decisions.
Influence the product roadmap so what gets built reflects willingness-to-pay signals, consumer needs, and portfolio strategy.
Own the multi-year evolution of Spotify’s subscription portfolio, including where the portfolio should sit two-to-three years out and the sequence of moves to get there.

Who You Are

You have deep commercial strategy experience in pricing, packaging, monetization, subscriptions, or consumer businesses.
You think structurally and can reason across an entire packaging-and-pricing system, not just a single product, feature, or number.
You have strong intuition for consumer behavior and behavioral economics, including how people perceive value, compare tiers, and make purchase decisions.
You have a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and building cross-functional consensus without direct authority.
You can move fluently between consumer language and commercial logic, and you are comfortable being the voice of the consumer in strategic discussions.
You have experience with Good-Better-Best architectures, feature gating, add-ons, bundles, or regional price laddering.
You may bring experience from strategy consulting, product strategy, corporate strategy, pricing, consumer tech, media, or subscription businesses.
Familiarity with content or rights licensing, and how it shapes product packaging, would be valuable.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in New York or Stockholm.
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

The United States base range for this position is $248,656 - $355,223, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

new_jobs.description:
Description

Worldwide Grocery Stores (WWGS) is a global retail organization dedicated to revolutionizing the grocery shopping experience through enhanced efficiency, quality, and affordability. At its core, WWGS Private Brands (PB) serves as a crucial strategic division that develops, sources, and manages proprietary food products for both Whole Foods Market (WFM) and Amazon-branded lines across all geographic regions.

Operating as a unified force, Private Brands supports both North American and International operations by leveraging cross-functional expertise in product development, sourcing, sensory evaluation, commercialization, and quality assurance to bring products to market end-to-end across all WFM and Amazon channels. This collaborative structure enables WWGS to deliver high-quality, innovative products while maintaining operational excellence across diverse global markets—rapidly scaling its food portfolio without compromising on quality standards or process efficiency.

WWGS PB APAC team manages “byAmazon” and Whole Foods Market Exclusive brands including “365”. We lead the growth of our Food PB assortment. We develop and execute the food PB expansion and growth strategy to support broader Grocery efforts across Core Consumables, Amazon Fresh, Quick Commerce, and Sub-Same Day Grocery by working across multiple channels and partner teams.

Sr. Product Research & Development Manager, WWGS PB APAC, is an entrepreneurial, creative, and data-driven role. The ideal candidate will be customer-focused, a proven self-starter, and have a demonstrated ability to innovate. This role will be responsible for supporting, developing, and executing product research, development and sensory initiatives in support of WWGS/WFM’s retail objectives. Also, this role conducts product-related customer research, performs data analysis, and works with WWGS/JP leadership to develop and position new products. We are looking for someone who combines a passion for consumers and food with a willingness to move fast and experiment often.

Additionally, this role requires the ability to influence multiple organizations, including WWGS, Core Consumables, Amazon Fresh, Express Mart, Quick Commerce, Food Safety, Legal, Operations, and Marketing. A strong project management skill is essential. Sr. Product Research & Development Manager will establish, drive, and strengthen relationships with both key private brand suppliers and internal stakeholders.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key job responsibilities

Business Ownership & Analytics

Lead product-related customer research and perform data analysis
Identify market trends and consumer insights to inform strategy, product development briefs, and business cases
Manage full product lifecycle from strategic ideation through commercialization, launch, and in-market optimization
Build and maintain long-term and annual product roadmap
Monitor and respond to customer feedback and sales metrics
Conduct weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews with data-driven insights and root cause analysis
Develop and maintain product dashboards with KPIs to track progress against goals
Optimize the critical Ps (Product, Price, Placement, Promotion) working with partner teams to bring products to life effectively
Make data-informed decisions leveraging both qualitative and quantitative customer insights
Collaborate with NA, EU, JP Category Merchant stakeholders to achieve financial plans and category objectives

Product Strategy & Development

Own end-to-end product lifecycle, working backwards from customer needs to develop compelling product roadmaps
Serve as subject matter expert within the private labeling space, understanding supplier landscape and optimizing portfolio
Drive new product creation and renovation of existing products to optimize total portfolio against business objectives
Partner with Legal, Quality and Food Safety to bring products to market efficiently while managing risk
Lead product development including category insights, formulation development with suppliers, cooking, preparation, sample presentations, and first production management

Sourcing Excellence

Develop and nurture strategic supplier partnerships to drive innovation and operational excellence
Establish and own relationships with key strategic suppliers to deliver product roadmap
Develop methodology for determining optimal assemblers and co-manufacturers for short and long term
Lead negotiation strategies to deliver against business objectives (safety, quality, cost, delivery) and achieve sustainable supplier relationships
Implement supplier score carding and performance management systems to ensure quality, sustainability, and business outcomes

Product Experience Optimization

Drive packaging innovation that enhances customer experience while supporting sustainability goals
Influence product placement decisions through data-driven insights and customer decision tree methodology

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate with and influence cross-functional teams and leaders
Communicate, represent, and uphold WWGS core values and leadership principles
Demonstrate bias for action, ownership mentality, and customer obsession in all activities

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of experience in product management, product development, sourcing in Food industry
Bachelor's degree, or 5+ years of professional experience
Experience using data to influence business decisions
Experience leading cross-functional teams to deliver projects on tight deadlines
Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English & Japanese), with experience negotiating and engaging stakeholders across multiple business units and senior management

Preferred Qualifications

Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams
3+ years of grocery leadership, or 6+ years of customer-facing retail, hospitality, or grocery industry experience
